sections.label: Glorification of the power of prayer and of Agni
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 1

verses.sa:
धीती वा ये अनयन् वाचो अग्रं मनसा वा येऽवदन्नृ तानि ।
तृतीयेन ब्रह्मणा वावृधानास्तुरीयेणामन्वत नाम धेनोः॥
verses.tr: dhītī vā ye anayan vāco agraṃ manasā vā ye'vadannṛ tāni tṛtīyena brahmaṇā vāvṛdhānāsturīyeṇāmanvata nāma dhenoḥ
verses.en: They who by thought have guided all that Speech hath best, or they who with their heart have uttered words of truth, Made stronger by the strength which the third prayer bestows, have by the fourth prayer learned the nature of the Cow.

verses.sa:
स वेद पुत्रः पितरं स मातरं स सूनुर्भुवत् स भुवत् पुनर्मघः ।
स द्यामौर्णोदन्तरिक्षं स्वः१ स इदं विश्वमभवत् स आभवत्॥
verses.tr: sa veda putraḥ pitaraṃ sa mātaraṃ sa sūnurbhuvat sa bhuvat punarmaghaḥ sa dyāmaurṇodantarikṣaṃ svaḥ1 sa idaṃ viśvamabhavat sa ābhavat
verses.en: Well knows this son his sire, he knows his mother well: he hath been son, and he hath been illiberal. He hath encompassed heaven, and air's mid-realm, and sky: he hath become this All; he hath come nigh to us.

sections.label: Praise of Atharvan
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 2

verses.sa:
अथर्वाणं पितरं देवबन्धुं मातुर्गर्भं पितुरसुं युवानम्।
य इमं यज्ञं मनसा चिकेत प्र णो वोचस्तमिहेह ब्रवः॥
verses.tr: atharvāṇaṃ pitaraṃ devabandhuṃ māturgarbhaṃ piturasuṃ yuvānam ya imaṃ yajñaṃ manasā ciketa pra ṇo vocastamiheha bravaḥ
verses.en: Invoke for us, proclaim in sundry places, the kinsman of the Gods, our sire Atharvan, His mother's germ, his father's breath, the youthful, who with his mind hath noticed this oblation.

sections.label: Praise of Agni as the Sun
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 3

verses.sa:
अया विष्ठा जनयन् कर्वराणि स हि घृणिरुरुर्वराय गातुः ।
स प्रत्युदैद् धरुणं मध्वो अग्रं स्वया तन्वाऽतन्वऽमैरयत॥
verses.tr: ayā viṣṭhā janayan karvarāṇi sa hi ghṛṇirururvarāya gātuḥ sa pratyudaid dharuṇaṃ madhvo agraṃ svayā tanvā'tanva'mairayata
verses.en: He, in this manner showing forth his exploits—for he, bright God, is our broad way for choosing—Rose up to meet his stay, the mead's best portion: of his own self he sent his body forward.

sections.label: To Vayu God of the Wind
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 4

verses.sa:
एकया च दशभिश्चा सुहुते द्वाभ्यामिष्टये विंशत्या च ।
तिसृभिश्च वहसे त्रिंशता च वियुग्भिर्वाय इह ता वि मुञ्च॥
verses.tr: ekayā ca daśabhiścā suhute dvābhyāmiṣṭaye viṃśatyā ca tisṛbhiśca vahase triṃśatā ca viyugbhirvāya iha tā vi muñca
verses.en: With thine eleven teams, to aid our wishes, yea, with thy two-and-twenty teams, O Vayu, With all thy three-and-thirty teams for drawing, here loose these teams, thou who art prompt to listen! Praise of Atharvan.

sections.label: A glorification of sacrifice
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 5

verses.sa:
यज्ञेन यज्ञमयजन्त देवास्तानि धर्माणि प्रथमान्यासन्।
ते ह नाकं महिमानः सचन्त यत्र पूर्वे साध्याः सन्ति देवाः॥
verses.tr: yajñena yajñamayajanta devāstāni dharmāṇi prathamānyāsan te ha nākaṃ mahimānaḥ sacanta yatra pūrve sādhyāḥ santi devāḥ
verses.en: The- Gods adored the Sacrifice with worship: these were the statutes of primeval ages. Those mighty ones attained the cope of heaven, there where the Sadhyas, Gods of old, are dwelling.

verses.sa:
यज्ञो बभूव स आ बभूव स प्र जज्ञे स उ वावृधे पुनः ।
स देवानामधिपतिर्बभूव सो अस्मासु द्रविणमा दधातु॥
verses.tr: yajño babhūva sa ā babhūva sa pra jajñe sa u vāvṛdhe punaḥ sa devānāmadhipatirbabhūva so asmāsu draviṇamā dadhātu
verses.en: Sacrifice was, was manifest among us: it sprang to life and then in time grew stronger. Then it became the deities' lord and ruler: may it bestow on us abundant riches.

verses.sa:
यद् देवा देवान् हविषायजन्तामर्त्यान् मनसामर्त्येन ।
मदेम तत्र परमे व्योऽमन् पश्येम तदुदितौ सूर्यस्य॥
verses.tr: yad devā devān haviṣāyajantāmartyān manasāmartyena madema tatra parame vyo'man paśyema taduditau sūryasya
verses.en: Where the Gods worshipped Gods with their oblation, worshipped immortals with immortal spirit, There in the loftiest heaven may we be happy, and look upon that light when Surya rises.

verses.sa:
यत् पुरुषेण हविषा यज्ञं देवा अतन्वत ।
अस्ति नु तस्मादोजीयो यद् विहव्येनेजिरे॥
verses.tr: yat puruṣeṇa haviṣā yajñaṃ devā atanvata asti nu tasmādojīyo yad vihavyenejire
verses.en: With their oblation, Purusha, the Gods performed a sacrifice. A sacrifice more potent still they paid with the invoking hymn.

verses.sa:
मुग्धा देवा उत शुनायजन्तोत गोरङ्गैः पुरुधायजन्त ।
य इमं यज्ञं मनसा चिकेत प्र णो वोचस्तमिहेह ब्रवः॥
verses.tr: mugdhā devā uta śunāyajantota goraṅgaiḥ purudhāyajanta ya imaṃ yajñaṃ manasā ciketa pra ṇo vocastamiheha bravaḥ
verses.en: With dog the Gods, perplexed, have paid oblation, and with cow's limbs in sundry sacrifices. Invoke for us, in many a place declare him who with his mind hath noticed this our worship.

sections.label: A prayer to Aditi for help and protection
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 6

verses.sa:
अदितिर्द्यौरदितिरन्तरिक्षमदितिर्माता स पिता स पुत्रः ।
विश्वे देवा अदितिः पञ्च जना अदितिर्जातमदितिर्जनित्वम्॥
verses.tr: aditirdyauraditirantarikṣamaditirmātā sa pitā sa putraḥ viśve devā aditiḥ pañca janā aditirjātamaditirjanitvam
verses.en: Aditi is the sky, and air's mid-region, Aditi is the father, son, and mother, Aditi all the Gods and the Five Nations, Aditi what is now and what is future.

verses.sa:
महीमू षु मातरं सुव्रतानामृतस्य पत्नीमवसे हवामहे ।
तुविक्षत्रामजरन्तीमुरूचीं सुशर्माणमदितिं सुप्रणीतिम्॥
verses.tr: mahīmū ṣu mātaraṃ suvratānāmṛtasya patnīmavase havāmahe tuvikṣatrāmajarantīmurūcīṃ suśarmāṇamaditiṃ supraṇītim
verses.en: We call for help the Queen of Law and Order, great mother of all those whose ways are righteous, Far-spread, unwasting, strong in her dominion, Aditi wisely leading, well protecting.

verses.sa:
सुत्रामाणं पृथिवीं द्यामनेहसं सुशर्माणमदितिं सुप्रणीतिम्।
दैवीं नावं स्वरित्रामनागसो अस्रवन्तीमा रुहेमा स्वस्तये॥
verses.tr: sutrāmāṇaṃ pṛthivīṃ dyāmanehasaṃ suśarmāṇamaditiṃ supraṇītim daivīṃ nāvaṃ svaritrāmanāgaso asravantīmā ruhemā svastaye
verses.en: Sinless may we ascend, for weal, the vessel, rowed with good oars, divine, that never leaketh, Earth, our strong guard, incomparable Heaven, Aditi wisely leading, well protecting.

verses.sa:
वाजस्य नु प्रसवे मातरं महीमदितिं नाम वचसा करामहे ।
यस्या उपस्थ उर्व१न्तरिक्षं सा नः शर्म त्रिवरूथं नि यच्छात्॥
verses.tr: vājasya nu prasave mātaraṃ mahīmaditiṃ nāma vacasā karāmahe yasyā upastha urva1ntarikṣaṃ sā naḥ śarma trivarūthaṃ ni yacchāt
verses.en: Let us bring hither, in pursuit of riches, Aditi with our word, the mighty mother, Her in whose lap the spacious air is lying: may she afford us triply-guarding shelter!

sections.label: Praise of the Adityas
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 7

verses.sa:
दितेः पुत्राणामदितेरकारिषमव देवानां बृहतामनर्मणाम्।
तेषां हि धाम गभिषक् समुद्रियं नैनान् नमसा परो अस्ति कश्चन॥
verses.tr: diteḥ putrāṇāmaditerakāriṣamava devānāṃ bṛhatāmanarmaṇām teṣāṃ hi dhāma gabhiṣak samudriyaṃ nainān namasā paro asti kaścana
verses.en: I Have sung praise to Diti's sons and Aditi's, those. very lofty and invulnerable Gods. For far within the depths of ocean is their home, and in the worship paid them none excelleth these.

sections.label: Godspeed to a departing traveller
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 8

verses.sa:
भद्रादधि श्रेयः प्रेहि बृहस्पतिः पुरएता ते अस्तु ।
अथेममस्या वर आ पृथिव्या आरेशत्रुं कृणुहि सर्ववीरम्॥
verses.tr: bhadrādadhi śreyaḥ prehi bṛhaspatiḥ puraetā te astu athemamasyā vara ā pṛthivyā āreśatruṃ kṛṇuhi sarvavīram
verses.en: Go forward on thy way from good to better: Brihaspati precede thy steps and guide thee! Place this man here, within this earth's enclosure, afar from foes with all his men about him. Praise of the Adityas.

sections.label: A prayer to Pushan for protection and the recovery of kg t property
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 9

verses.sa:
प्रपथे पथामजनिष्ट पूषा प्रपथे दिवः प्रपथे पृथिव्याः ।
उभे अभि प्रियतमे सधस्थे आ च परा च चरति प्रजानन्॥
verses.tr: prapathe pathāmajaniṣṭa pūṣā prapathe divaḥ prapathe pṛthivyāḥ ubhe abhi priyatame sadhasthe ā ca parā ca carati prajānan
verses.en: Pushan was born to move on distant pathways, on roads remote from earth, remote from heaven. To both most lovely places of assembly he travels and returns with perfect knowledge.

verses.sa:
पूषेमा आशा अनु वेद सर्वाः सो अस्माँ अभयतमेन नेषत्।
स्वस्तिदा आघृणिः सर्ववीरोऽप्रयुच्छन् पुर एतु प्रजानन्॥
verses.tr: pūṣemā āśā anu veda sarvāḥ so asmāṃ abhayatamena neṣat svastidā āghṛṇiḥ sarvavīro'prayucchan pura etu prajānan
verses.en: Pushan knows all these realms: may he conduct us by ways that are most free from fear and danger. Giver of blessings, glowing, all heroic, may he the wise and watchful go before us.

verses.sa:
पूषन्तव व्रते वयं न रिष्येम कदा चन।
स्तोतारस्त इह स्मसि॥
verses.tr: pūṣantava vrate vayaṃ na riṣyema kadā cana stotārasta iha smasi
verses.en: We are thy praisers here, O Pushan: never let us be injured under thy protection.

verses.sa:
परि पूषा परस्ताद्धस्तं दधातु दक्षिणम्।
पुनर्नो नष्टमाजतु सं नष्टेन गमेमहि॥
verses.tr: pari pūṣā parastāddhastaṃ dadhātu dakṣiṇam punarno naṣṭamājatu saṃ naṣṭena gamemahi
verses.en: From out the distance, far and wide, may Pushan stretch his right hand forth. Let him drive back our lost to us, let us return with what is lost.

sections.label: A prayer for the favour of Sarasvat!
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 10

verses.sa:
यस्ते स्तनः शशयुर्यो मयोभूर्यः सुम्नयुः सुहवो यः सुदत्रः ।
येन विश्वा पुष्यसि वार्याणि सरस्वति तमिह धातवे कः॥
verses.tr: yaste stanaḥ śaśayuryo mayobhūryaḥ sumnayuḥ suhavo yaḥ sudatraḥ yena viśvā puṣyasi vāryāṇi sarasvati tamiha dhātave kaḥ
verses.en: That breast of thine, exhaustless and delightful, good to invoke, beneficent, free giver, Wherewith thou feedest all things that are choicest, bring that, Sarasvati, that we may drain it.

sections.label: A prayer to protect corn from lightning and drought
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 11

verses.sa:
यस्ते स्तनः शशयुर्यो मयोभूर्यः सुम्नयुः सुहवो यः सुदत्रः ।
येन विश्वा पुष्यसि वार्याणि सरस्वति तमिह धातवे कः॥
verses.tr: yaste stanaḥ śaśayuryo mayobhūryaḥ sumnayuḥ suhavo yaḥ sudatraḥ yena viśvā puṣyasi vāryāṇi sarasvati tamiha dhātave kaḥ
verses.en: That far-spread thunder, sent from thee, which cometh on all this world, a high celestial signal—Strike not, O God, our growing corn with lightning, nor kill it with the burning rays of Surya.

sections.label: A prayer for influence at deliberative and religious meetings
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 12

verses.sa:
सभा च मा समितिश्चावतां प्रजापतेर्दुहितरौ संविदाने।
येना संगच्छा उप मा स शिक्षाच्चारु वदानि पितरः संगतेषु॥
verses.tr: sabhā ca mā samitiścāvatāṃ prajāpaterduhitarau saṃvidāne yenā saṃgacchā upa mā sa śikṣāccāru vadāni pitaraḥ saṃgateṣu
verses.en: In concord may Prajapati's two daughters, Gathering and Assembly, both protect me. May every man I meet respect and aid me. Fair be my words, O Fathers, at the meetings.

verses.sa:
विद्म ते सभे नाम नरिष्टा नाम वा असि ।
ये ते के च सभासदस्ते मे सन्तु सवाचसः॥
verses.tr: vidma te sabhe nāma nariṣṭā nāma vā asi ye te ke ca sabhāsadaste me santu savācasaḥ
verses.en: We know thy name, O Conference: thy name is interchange of talk. Let all the company who join the Conference agree with me.

verses.sa:
एषामहं समासीनानां वर्चो विज्ञानमा ददे ।
अस्याः सर्वस्याः संसदो मामिन्द्र भगिनं कृणु॥
verses.tr: eṣāmahaṃ samāsīnānāṃ varco vijñānamā dade asyāḥ sarvasyāḥ saṃsado māmindra bhaginaṃ kṛṇu
verses.en: Of these men seated here I make the splendour and the lore mine own. Indra, make me conspicuous in all this gathered company.

verses.sa:
यद् वो मनः परागतं यद् बद्धमिह वेह वा ।
तद् व आ वर्तयामसि मयि वो रमतां मनः॥
verses.tr: yad vo manaḥ parāgataṃ yad baddhamiha veha vā tad va ā vartayāmasi mayi vo ramatāṃ manaḥ
verses.en: Whether your thoughts are turned away, or bound and fastened here or there, i We draw them hitherward again: let your mind firmly rest; on me.

sections.label: A charm to win superiority over foes and rivals
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 13

verses.sa:
यथा सूर्यो नक्षत्राणामुद्यंस्तेजांस्याददे।
एवा स्त्रीणां च पुंसां च द्विषतां वर्च आ ददे॥
verses.tr: yathā sūryo nakṣatrāṇāmudyaṃstejāṃsyādade evā strīṇāṃ ca puṃsāṃ ca dviṣatāṃ varca ā dade
verses.en: As the Sun, rising, taketh to himself the brightness of the stars, So I assume the glory of women and men mine enemies.

verses.sa:
यावन्तो मा सपत्नानामायन्तं प्रतिपश्यथ ।
उद्यन्त्सूर्य इव सुप्तानां द्विषतां वर्च आ ददे॥
verses.tr: yāvanto mā sapatnānāmāyantaṃ pratipaśyatha udyantsūrya iva suptānāṃ dviṣatāṃ varca ā dade
verses.en: All ye among my rivals who behold me as I come to you, I seize the glory of my foes as the Sun, rising, theirs who sleep.

sections.label: A prayer to Savitar for prosperity
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 14

verses.sa:
अभि त्यं देवं सवितारमोण्योः कविक्रतुम्।
अर्चामि सत्यसवं रत्नधामभि प्रियं मतिम्॥
verses.tr: abhi tyaṃ devaṃ savitāramoṇyoḥ kavikratum arcāmi satyasavaṃ ratnadhāmabhi priyaṃ matim
verses.en: I praise this God, parent of heaven and earth, exceeding wise, possessed of real energy, giver of treasure, thinker dear to all,

verses.sa:
उर्ध्वा यस्यामतिर्भा अदिद्युतत् सवीमनि ।
हिरण्यपाणिरमिमीत सुक्रतुः कृपात् स्वः॥
verses.tr: urdhvā yasyāmatirbhā adidyutat savīmani hiraṇyapāṇiramimīta sukratuḥ kṛpāt svaḥ
verses.en: Whose splendour is sublime, whose light shone brilliant in creation, who, wise, and golden-handed, in his beauty made the sky.

verses.sa:
सावीर्हि देव प्रथमाय पित्रे वर्ष्माणमस्मै वरिमाणमस्मै ।
अथास्मभ्यं सवितर्वार्याणि दिवोदिव आ सुवा भूरि पश्वः॥
verses.tr: sāvīrhi deva prathamāya pitre varṣmāṇamasmai varimāṇamasmai athāsmabhyaṃ savitarvāryāṇi divodiva ā suvā bhūri paśvaḥ
verses.en: As thou, God! quickening, for our ancient father, sentest him height above and room about him, So unto us, O Savitar, send treasures, abundant, day by day, in shape of cattle.

verses.sa:
दमूना देवः सविता वरेण्यो दधद् रत्नं दक्षं पितृभ्य आयूंषि ।
पिबात् सोमं ममददेनमिष्टे परिज्मा चित् क्रमते अस्य धर्मणि॥
verses.tr: damūnā devaḥ savitā vareṇyo dadhad ratnaṃ dakṣaṃ pitṛbhya āyūṃṣi pibāt somaṃ mamadadenamiṣṭe parijmā cit kramate asya dharmaṇi
verses.en: Savitar, God, our household friend, most precious, hath sent our fathers life and power and riches. Let him drink Soma and rejoice when worshipped. Under his law even the Wanderer travels.

sections.label: A charm to win divine favour and felicity
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 15

verses.sa:
तां सवितः सत्यसवां सुचित्रामाहं वृणे सुमतिं विश्ववाराम्।
यामस्य कण्वो अदुहन् प्रपीनां सहस्रधारां महिषो भगाय॥
verses.tr: tāṃ savitaḥ satyasavāṃ sucitrāmāhaṃ vṛṇe sumatiṃ viśvavārām yāmasya kaṇvo aduhan prapīnāṃ sahasradhārāṃ mahiṣo bhagāya
verses.en: I Choose, O Savitar, that glorious favour, with fruitful energy and every blessing, Even this one's teeming cow, erst milked by Kanva, thousand-streamed, milked for happiness by the mighty.

sections.label: A prayer for prosperity
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 16

verses.sa:
बृहस्पते सवितर्वर्धयैनं ज्योतयैनं महते सौभगाय ।
संशितं चित् संतरं सं शिशाधि विश्व एनमनु मदन्तु देवाः॥
verses.tr: bṛhaspate savitarvardhayainaṃ jyotayainaṃ mahate saubhagāya saṃśitaṃ cit saṃtaraṃ saṃ śiśādhi viśva enamanu madantu devāḥ
verses.en: Increase this man Brihaspati! Illume him, O Savitar, for high and happy fortune. Sharpen him throughly though already sharpened: with glad acclaim let all the Gods receive him.

sections.label: A prayer for wealth and children
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 17

verses.sa:
धाता दधातु नो रयिमीशानो जगतस्पतिः ।
स नः पूर्णेन यच्छतु॥
verses.tr: dhātā dadhātu no rayimīśāno jagataspatiḥ sa naḥ pūrṇena yacchatu
verses.en: May the Ordainer give us wealth, Lord, ruler of the world of life: with full hand may he give to us.

verses.sa:
धाता दधातु दाशुषे प्राचीं जीवातुक्षिताम्।
वयं देवस्य धीमहि सुमतिं विश्वराधसः॥
verses.tr: dhātā dadhātu dāśuṣe prācīṃ jīvātukṣitām vayaṃ devasya dhīmahi sumatiṃ viśvarādhasaḥ
verses.en: May Dhatar grant the worshipper henceforth imperishable life. May we obtain the favour of the God who giveth every boon.

verses.sa:
धाता विश्वा वार्या दधातु प्रजाकामाय दाशुषे दुरोणे।
तस्मै देवाअमृतं सं व्ययन्तु विश्वे देवा अदितिः सजोषाः॥
verses.tr: dhātā viśvā vāryā dadhātu prajākāmāya dāśuṣe duroṇe tasmai devāamṛtaṃ saṃ vyayantu viśve devā aditiḥ sajoṣāḥ
verses.en: To him may Dhatar grant all kinds of blessings who, craving children, serves him in his dwelling. Him may the Gods invest with life eternal, yea, all the Gods and Aditi accordant.

verses.sa:
धाता रातिः सवितेदं जुषन्तां प्रजापतिर्निधिपतिर्नो अग्निः ।
त्वष्टा विष्णुः प्रजया संरराणो यजमानाय द्रविणं दधातु॥
verses.tr: dhātā rātiḥ savitedaṃ juṣantāṃ prajāpatirnidhipatirno agniḥ tvaṣṭā viṣṇuḥ prajayā saṃrarāṇo yajamānāya draviṇaṃ dadhātu
verses.en: May this our gift please Savitar, Rati, Dhatar, Prajapati, and Agni Lord of Treasures. May Tvashtar, Vishnu, blessing him with children, give store of riches to the sacrificer.

sections.label: A prayer for rain
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 18

verses.sa:
प्र नभस्व पृथिवि भिन्द्धी३दं दिव्यं नभः ।
उद्नो दिव्यस्य नो धातरीशानो वि ष्या दृतिम्॥
verses.tr: pra nabhasva pṛthivi bhinddhī3daṃ divyaṃ nabhaḥ udno divyasya no dhātarīśāno vi ṣyā dṛtim
verses.en: Burst open, Prithivi, and cleave asunder this celestial cloud. Untie, O Dhatar—for thou canst—the bottle of the breast of heaven.

verses.sa:
न घ्रंस्तताप न हिमो जघान प्र नभतां पृथिवी जीरदानुः ।
आपश्चिदस्मै घृतमित् क्षरन्ति यत्र सोमः सदमित् तत्र भद्रम्॥
verses.tr: na ghraṃstatāpa na himo jaghāna pra nabhatāṃ pṛthivī jīradānuḥ āpaścidasmai ghṛtamit kṣaranti yatra somaḥ sadamit tatra bhadram
verses.en: Let not the Sun's heat burn, nor cold destroy her. Let Earth with all her quickening drops burst open. Even for her the waters flow, and fatness: where Soma is even there is bliss for ever.

sections.label: A prayer for prosperity
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 19

verses.sa:
प्रजापतिर्जनयति प्रजा इमा धाता दधातु सुमनस्यमानः ।
संजानानाः संमनसः सयोनयो मयि पुष्टं पुष्टपतिर्दधातु॥
verses.tr: prajāpatirjanayati prajā imā dhātā dadhātu sumanasyamānaḥ saṃjānānāḥ saṃmanasaḥ sayonayo mayi puṣṭaṃ puṣṭapatirdadhātu
verses.en: Prajapati engenders earthly creatures: may the benevolent Ordainer form them, Having one common womb, and mind, and spirit. He who is Lord of Plenty give me plenty!

sections.label: A prayer for prosperity and happiness
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 20

verses.sa:
अन्वद्य नोऽनुमतिर्यज्ञं देवेषु मन्यताम्।
अग्निश्च हव्यवाहनो भवतां दाशुषे मम॥
verses.tr: anvadya no'numatiryajñaṃ deveṣu manyatām agniśca havyavāhano bhavatāṃ dāśuṣe mama
verses.en: Anumati approve to-day our sacrifice among the Gods! May Agni bear mine offerings away for me the worshipper.

verses.sa:
अन्विदनुमते त्वं मंससे शं च नस्कृधि ।
जुषस्व हव्यमाहुतं प्रजां देवि ररास्व नः॥
verses.tr: anvidanumate tvaṃ maṃsase śaṃ ca naskṛdhi juṣasva havyamāhutaṃ prajāṃ devi rarāsva naḥ
verses.en: Do thou, Anumati! J approve, and grant us health and happiness. Accept the offered sacrifice, and, Goddess, give us progeny.

verses.sa:
अनु मन्यतामनुमन्यमानः प्रजावन्तं रयिमक्षीयमाणम्।
तस्य वयं हेडसि मापि भूम सुमृडीके अस्य सुमतौ स्याम॥
verses.tr: anu manyatāmanumanyamānaḥ prajāvantaṃ rayimakṣīyamāṇam tasya vayaṃ heḍasi māpi bhūma sumṛḍīke asya sumatau syāma
verses.en: May he approving in return accord us wealth inexhaustible with store of children. Never may we be subject to his anger, but rest in his benevolence and mercy.

verses.sa:
यत् ते नाम सुहवं सुप्रणीतेऽनुमते अनुमतं सुदानु ।
तेना नो यज्ञं पिपृहि विश्ववारे रयिं नो धेहि सुभगे सुवीरम्॥
verses.tr: yat te nāma suhavaṃ supraṇīte'numate anumataṃ sudānu tenā no yajñaṃ pipṛhi viśvavāre rayiṃ no dhehi subhage suvīram
verses.en: Thy name is easy to invoke, good leader! approved, Anumati I and rich in bounty. Source of all boons! fill up therewith our worship, and, Blest One! grant us wealth with goodly heroes.

verses.sa:
एमं यज्ञमनुमतिर्जगाम सुक्षेत्रतायै सुवीरतायै सुजातम्।
भद्रा ह्यऽस्याः प्रमतिर्बभूव सेमं यज्ञमवतु देवगोपा॥
verses.tr: emaṃ yajñamanumatirjagāma sukṣetratāyai suvīratāyai sujātam bhadrā hya'syāḥ pramatirbabhūva semaṃ yajñamavatu devagopā
verses.en: Anumati hath come to this our worship well-formed to give good lands and valiant heroes: For her kind care hath blessed us. God-protected, may she assist the sacrifice we offer.

verses.sa:
अनुमतिः सर्वमिदं बभूव यत् तिष्ठति चरति यदु च विश्वमेजति ।
तस्यास्ते देवि सुमतौ स्यामानुमते अनु हि मंससे नः॥
verses.tr: anumatiḥ sarvamidaṃ babhūva yat tiṣṭhati carati yadu ca viśvamejati tasyāste devi sumatau syāmānumate anu hi maṃsase naḥ
verses.en: Anumati became this All, whatever standeth or walketh, everything that moveth. May we enjoy thy. gracious love, O Goddess. Regard us, O Anumati, with favour.

sections.label: A funeral stanza
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 21

verses.sa:
समेत विश्वे वचसा पतिं दिव एको विभूरतिथिर्जनानाम्।
स पूर्व्यो नूतनमाविवासत् तं वर्तनिरनु वावृत एकमित् पुरु॥
verses.tr: sameta viśve vacasā patiṃ diva eko vibhūratithirjanānām sa pūrvyo nūtanamāvivāsat taṃ vartaniranu vāvṛta ekamit puru
verses.en: With prayer come all together to the Lord of Heaven: he is the peerless one, far-reaching, guest of men. He, God of ancient time, hath gained a recent thrall: to him alone is turned the path which all must tread.

sections.label: To Savitar, or Yama invested with: Savitar's attributes
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 22

verses.sa: अयं सहस्रमा नो दृशे कवीनां मतिर्ज्योतिर्विधर्मणि॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ sahasramā no dṛśe kavīnāṃ matirjyotirvidharmaṇi
verses.en: Unto a thousand sages he hath given sight: thought, light is he in ranging all.

verses.sa:
ब्रध्नः समीचीरुषसः समैरयन्।
अरेपसः सचेतसः स्वसरे मन्युमत्तमाश्चिते गोः॥
verses.tr: bradhnaḥ samīcīruṣasaḥ samairayan arepasaḥ sacetasaḥ svasare manyumattamāścite goḥ
verses.en: The Bright One hath sent forth the Dawns, a closely gathered band, Immaculate, unanimous, brightly refulgent in their homes.

sections.label: A charm to banish fiends and troubles
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 23

verses.sa:
दौष्वप्न्यं दौर्जीवित्यं रक्षो अभ्वऽमराय्यः ।
दुर्णाम्नीः सर्वा दुर्वाचस्ता अस्मन्नाशयामसि॥
verses.tr: dauṣvapnyaṃ daurjīvityaṃ rakṣo abhva'marāyyaḥ durṇāmnīḥ sarvā durvācastā asmannāśayāmasi
verses.en: The fearful dream, and indigence, the monster, the malignant hags, All female fiends of evil name and wicked tongue we drive afar.

sections.label: A prayer for riches
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 24

verses.sa:
यन्न इन्द्रो अखनद् यदग्निर्विश्वे देवा मरुतो यत् स्वर्काः ।
तदस्मभ्यं सविता सत्यधर्मा प्रजापतिरनुमतिर्नि यच्छात्॥
verses.tr: yanna indro akhanad yadagnirviśve devā maruto yat svarkāḥ tadasmabhyaṃ savitā satyadharmā prajāpatiranumatirni yacchāt
verses.en: What treasure hath been dug for us by Indra, by Agni, Visvedevas, tuneful Maruts, On us may Savitar whose laws are faithful, Prajapati, and Heavenly Grace bestow it.

sections.label: Praise of Vishnu and Varuna
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 25

verses.sa:
ययोरोजसा स्कभिता रजांसि यौ वीर्यौऽर्वीरतमा शविष्ठा ।
यौ पत्येते अप्रतीतौ सहोभिर्विष्णुमगन् वरुणं पूर्वहूतिः॥
verses.tr: yayorojasā skabhitā rajāṃsi yau vīryau'rvīratamā śaviṣṭhā yau patyete apratītau sahobhirviṣṇumagan varuṇaṃ pūrvahūtiḥ
verses.en: The early morning prayer hath come to Vishnu and Varuna, Lords through might, whom none hath equalled, Gods by whose power the realms of air were stablished, strongest and most heroic in their vigour.

verses.sa:
यस्येदं प्रदिशि यद् विरोचते प्र चानति वि च चष्टे शचीभिः ।
पुरा देवस्य धर्मणा सहोभिर्विष्णुमगन् वरुणं पूर्वहूतिः॥
verses.tr: yasyedaṃ pradiśi yad virocate pra cānati vi ca caṣṭe śacībhiḥ purā devasya dharmaṇā sahobhirviṣṇumagan varuṇaṃ pūrvahūtiḥ
verses.en: The early prayer hath ever come to Vishnu and Varuna by that God's high power and statute. In whose control is all this world that shineth, all that hath powers to see and all that breatheth.

sections.label: Praise of Vishnu
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 26

verses.sa:
विष्णोर्नु कं प्रा वोचं वीर्याऽणि यः पार्थिवानि विममे रजांसि ।
यो अस्कभायदुत्तरं सधस्थं विचक्रमाणस्त्रेधोरुगायः॥
verses.tr: viṣṇornu kaṃ prā vocaṃ vīryā'ṇi yaḥ pārthivāni vimame rajāṃsi yo askabhāyaduttaraṃ sadhasthaṃ vicakramāṇastredhorugāyaḥ
verses.en: I Will declare the mighty deeds of Vishnu, of him who measured out the earthly regions, Who propped the highest place of congregation, thrice setting down his footstep, widely striding.

verses.sa:
प्र तद् विष्णु स्तवते वीर्याऽणि मृगो न भीमः कुचरो गिरिष्ठाः ।
परावत आ जगम्यात् परस्याः॥
verses.tr: pra tad viṣṇu stavate vīryā'ṇi mṛgo na bhīmaḥ kucaro giriṣṭhāḥ parāvata ā jagamyāt parasyāḥ
verses.en: Loud boast doth Vishnu make of this achievement, like some wild beast, dread, prowling, mountain-roaming. May he approach us from the farthest distance.

verses.sa:
यस्योरुषु त्रिषु विक्रमनेष्वधिक्षियन्ति भुवनानि विश्वा ।
उरु विष्णो वि क्रमस्वोरु क्षयाय नस्कृधि ।
घृतं घृतयोने पिब प्रप्र यज्ञपतिं तिर॥
verses.tr: yasyoruṣu triṣu vikramaneṣvadhikṣiyanti bhuvanāni viśvā uru viṣṇo vi kramasvoru kṣayāya naskṛdhi ghṛtaṃ ghṛtayone piba prapra yajñapatiṃ tira
verses.en: Thou within whose three wide-extended paces all worlds and creatures have their habitation, Drink oil, thou homed in oil! promote the sacrificer more and more.

verses.sa:
इदं विष्णुर्वि चक्रमे त्रेधा नि दधे पदा।
समूढमस्य पांसुरे॥
verses.tr: idaṃ viṣṇurvi cakrame tredhā ni dadhe padā samūḍhamasya pāṃsure
verses.en: Through all this world strode Vishnu: thrice his foot he planted, and the whole Was gathered in his footstep's dust.

verses.sa:
त्रीणि पदा वि चक्रमे विष्णुर्गोपा अदाभ्यः ।
इतो धर्माणि धारयन्॥
verses.tr: trīṇi padā vi cakrame viṣṇurgopā adābhyaḥ ito dharmāṇi dhārayan
verses.en: Vishnu the guardian, he whom none deceiveth, made three steps, thenceforth. Establishing these high decrees.

verses.sa:
विष्णोः कर्माणि पश्यत यतो व्रतानि पस्पशे।
इन्द्रस्य युज्यः सखा॥
verses.tr: viṣṇoḥ karmāṇi paśyata yato vratāni paspaśe indrasya yujyaḥ sakhā
verses.en: Look ye on Vishnu's works, whereby the friend of Indra, close-allied, Hath let his holy ways be seen.

verses.sa:
तद् विष्णोः परमं पदं सदा पश्यन्ति सूरयः ।
दिवीऽव चक्षुराततम्॥
verses.tr: tad viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padaṃ sadā paśyanti sūrayaḥ divī'va cakṣurātatam
verses.en: The princes evermore behold that loftiest place where Vishnu is, Like an extended eye in heaven.

verses.sa:
दिवो विष्ण उत वा पृथिव्या महो विष्ण उरोरन्तरिक्षात्।
हस्तौ पृणस्व बहुभिर्वसव्यैराप्रयच्छ दक्षिणादोत सव्यात्॥
verses.tr: divo viṣṇa uta vā pṛthivyā maho viṣṇa urorantarikṣāt hastau pṛṇasva bahubhirvasavyairāprayaccha dakṣiṇādota savyāt
verses.en: From heaven, O Vishnu, j or from earth, O Vishnu, or from the great far-spreading air's mid-region, Fill both thy hands full of abundant treasures, and from the right and left bestow them freely.

sections.label: A prayer to Ida, Goddess of Devotion
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 27

verses.sa:
इडैवास्मां अनु वस्तां व्रतेन यस्याः पदे पुनते देवयन्तः ।
घृतपदी शक्वरी सोमपृष्ठोप यज्ञमस्थित वैश्वदेवी॥
verses.tr: iḍaivāsmāṃ anu vastāṃ vratena yasyāḥ pade punate devayantaḥ ghṛtapadī śakvarī somapṛṣṭhopa yajñamasthita vaiśvadevī
verses.en: May Ida with her statute dwell beside us, she in whose place the pious purge and cleanse them. She, mighty, Soma-decked, whose foot drops fatness, meet for All-gods, hath come to aid our worship.

sections.label: Praise of the sacrificial utensils
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 28

verses.sa:
वेदः स्वस्तिर्द्रुघणः स्वस्तिः परशुर्वेदिः परशुर्नः स्वस्ति।
हविष्कृतो यज्ञिया यज्ञकामास्ते देवासो यज्ञमिमं जुषन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: vedaḥ svastirdrughaṇaḥ svastiḥ paraśurvediḥ paraśurnaḥ svasti haviṣkṛto yajñiyā yajñakāmāste devāso yajñamimaṃ juṣantām
verses.en: Blest be the Broom, may the Mace bring a blessing, and may the Altar and the Hatchet bless us. Worshipful Gods, may they accept this worship, lovers of sacrifice, and sacrifices.

sections.label: To Agni and Vishnu
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 29

verses.sa:
अग्नाविष्णू महि तद् वां महित्व पाथो घृतस्य गुह्यस्य नाम ।
दमेदमे सप्त रत्ना दधानौ प्रति वां जिह्वा घृतमा चरण्यात्॥
verses.tr: agnāviṣṇū mahi tad vāṃ mahitva pātho ghṛtasya guhyasya nāma damedame sapta ratnā dadhānau prati vāṃ jihvā ghṛtamā caraṇyāt
verses.en: This is your glorious might, Agni and Vishnu! Ye drink the essence of the mystic butter, Placing in every home seven costly treasures. Let your tongue stretch to take the offered fatness.

verses.sa:
अग्नाविष्णू महि धाम प्रियं वां वीथो घृतस्य गुह्या जुषाणौ।
दमेदमे सुष्टुत्या वावृधानौ प्रति वां जिह्वा घृतमुच्चरण्यात्॥
verses.tr: agnāviṣṇū mahi dhāma priyaṃ vāṃ vītho ghṛtasya guhyā juṣāṇau damedame suṣṭutyā vāvṛdhānau prati vāṃ jihvā ghṛtamuccaraṇyāt
verses.en: Ye love the great law, Agni Vishnu! joying, ye feast on mystic essences of butter, Exalted in each house with fair laudation. Let your tongue stretch to take the offered fatness.

sections.label: A charm to be used when the eyes are anointed
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 30

verses.sa:
स्वाक्तं मे द्यावापृथिवी स्वाक्तं मित्रो अकरयम्।
स्वाक्तं मे ब्रह्मणस्पतिः स्वाक्तं सविता करत्॥
verses.tr: svāktaṃ me dyāvāpṛthivī svāktaṃ mitro akarayam svāktaṃ me brahmaṇaspatiḥ svāktaṃ savitā karat
verses.en: Heaven, Earth, and Mitra here have caused mine eyes to be anointed well, Savitar, Brahmanaspati take care that they be duly balmed!

sections.label: A prayer for the overthrow of enemies
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 31

verses.sa:
इन्द्रोतिभिर्बहुलाभिर्नो अद्य यावच्छ्रेष्ठाभिर्मघवन्छूर जिन्व ।
यो नो द्वेष्ट्यधर सस्पदीष्ट यमु द्विष्मस्तमु प्राणो जहातु॥
verses.tr: indrotibhirbahulābhirno adya yāvacchreṣṭhābhirmaghavanchūra jinva yo no dveṣṭyadhara saspadīṣṭa yamu dviṣmastamu prāṇo jahātu
verses.en: Rouse us to-day O Indra, Maghavan, hero, with thy best possible and varied succours. May he who hateth us fall low beneath us, and him whom we detest let life abandon.

sections.label: A prayer to Agni for long life
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 32

verses.sa:
उप प्रियं पनिप्नतं युवानमाहुतीवृधम्।
अगन्म बिभ्रतो नमो दीर्घमायुः कृणोतु मे॥
verses.tr: upa priyaṃ panipnataṃ yuvānamāhutīvṛdham aganma bibhrato namo dīrghamāyuḥ kṛṇotu me
verses.en: "We bringing homage have approached the friend who seeks our wondering praise, Young, strengthener of the sacrifice. May he bestow long life on me.

sections.label: A prayer for long life, children, and riches
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 33

verses.sa:
सं मा सिञ्चन्तु मरुतः सं पूषा सं बृहस्पतिः ।
सं मायमग्निः सिञ्चतु प्रजया च धनेन च दीर्घमायुः कृणोतु मे॥
verses.tr: saṃ mā siñcantu marutaḥ saṃ pūṣā saṃ bṛhaspatiḥ saṃ māyamagniḥ siñcatu prajayā ca dhanena ca dīrghamāyuḥ kṛṇotu me
verses.en: Let Pushan, let the Maruts, let Brihaspati pour forth on me; This present Agni pour on me children and riches in a stream! J May he bestow long life on me. A prayer for long life, children, and riches. a

sections.label: A prayer for freedom from sin and the overthrow of enemies
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 34

verses.sa:
अग्ने जातान् प्र णुदा मे सपत्नान् प्रत्यजातान् जातवेदो नुदस्व ।
अधस्पदं कृणुष्व ये पृतन्यवोऽनागसस्ते वयमदितये स्याम॥
verses.tr: agne jātān pra ṇudā me sapatnān pratyajātān jātavedo nudasva adhaspadaṃ kṛṇuṣva ye pṛtanyavo'nāgasaste vayamaditaye syāma
verses.en: Agni, drive off my rivals born and living, repel those yet unborn, O Jatavedas. Cast down beneath my feet mine adversaries. In Aditi's regard may we be sinless.

sections.label: A prayer for the prosperity of a King and his kingdom
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 35

verses.sa:
प्रान्यान्त्सपत्नान्त्सहसा सहस्व प्रत्यजातान् जातवेदो नुदस्व ।
इदं राष्ट्रं पिपृहि सौभगाय विश्व एनमनु मदन्तु देवाः॥
verses.tr: prānyāntsapatnāntsahasā sahasva pratyajātān jātavedo nudasva idaṃ rāṣṭraṃ pipṛhi saubhagāya viśva enamanu madantu devāḥ
verses.en: Subdue with conquering might his other rivals, those yet unborn repel, O Jatavedas. For great felicity protect this kingdom, and in this man let all the Gods be joyful.

verses.sa:
इमा यास्ते शतं हिराः सहस्रं धमनीरुत।
तासां ते सर्वासामहमश्मना बिलमप्यधाम्॥
परं योनेरवरं ते कृणोमि मा त्वा प्रजाभि भून्मोत सूनुः ।
अस्वं१ त्वाप्रजसं कृणोम्यश्मानं ते अपिधानं कृणोमि॥
verses.tr: imā yāste śataṃ hirāḥ sahasraṃ dhamanīruta tāsāṃ te sarvāsāmahamaśmanā bilamapyadhām paraṃ yoneravaraṃ te kṛṇomi mā tvā prajābhi bhūnmota sūnuḥ asvaṃ1 tvāprajasaṃ kṛṇomyaśmānaṃ te apidhānaṃ kṛṇomi
verses.en: [Griffith gives stanzas 2 and 3 only in a Latin version, in the Appendix to his translation: 'Stanzas 2 and 3 have a totally different object.']

sections.label: A charm to be pronounced by bride and bridegroom
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 36

verses.sa:
अक्ष्यौऽनौ मधुसंकाशे अनीकं नौ समञ्जनम्।
अन्तः कृष्णुष्व मां हृदि मन इन्नौ सहासति॥
verses.tr: akṣyau'nau madhusaṃkāśe anīkaṃ nau samañjanam antaḥ kṛṣṇuṣva māṃ hṛdi mana innau sahāsati
verses.en: Sweet are the glances of our eyes, our faces are as smooth as balm. Within thy bosom harbour me; one spirit dwell in both of us!

sections.label: A nuptial charm to be spoken by the bride
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 37

verses.sa:
अभि त्वा मनुजातेन दधामि मम वाससा ।
यथासो मम केवलो नान्यासां कीर्तयाश्चन॥
verses.tr: abhi tvā manujātena dadhāmi mama vāsasā yathāso mama kevalo nānyāsāṃ kīrtayāścana
verses.en: With this my robe, inherited from Manu, I envelop thee, So that thou mayst be all mine own and give no thought to other dames.

sections.label: A maiden's love-charm
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 38

verses.sa:
इदं खनामि भेषजं मांपश्यमभिरोरुदम्।
परायतो निवर्तनमायतः प्रतिनन्दनम्॥
verses.tr: idaṃ khanāmi bheṣajaṃ māṃpaśyamabhirorudam parāyato nivartanamāyataḥ pratinandanam
verses.en: I Dig this Healing Herb that makes my lover look on me and weep; J That bids the parting friend return and kindly greets him as he comes.

verses.sa:
येना निचक्र आसुरीन्द्रं देवेभ्यस्परि ।
तेना नि कुर्वे त्वामहं यथा तेऽसानि सुप्रिया॥
verses.tr: yenā nicakra āsurīndraṃ devebhyaspari tenā ni kurve tvāmahaṃ yathā te'sāni supriyā
verses.en: This Herb wherewith the Asuri drew Indra downward from the Gods, With this same Herb I draw thee close that I may be most dear to thee.

verses.sa:
प्रतीची सोममसि प्रतीच्युत सूर्यम्।
प्रतीची विश्वान् देवान् तां त्वाच्छावदामसि॥
verses.tr: pratīcī somamasi pratīcyuta sūryam pratīcī viśvān devān tāṃ tvācchāvadāmasi
verses.en: Thou art the peer of Soma, yea, thou art the equal of the Sun, The peer of all the Gods art thou: therefore we call thee hitherward.

verses.sa:
अहं वदामि नेत् त्वं सभायामह त्वं वद ।
ममेदसस्त्वं केवलो नान्यासां कीर्तयाश्चन॥
verses.tr: ahaṃ vadāmi net tvaṃ sabhāyāmaha tvaṃ vada mamedasastvaṃ kevalo nānyāsāṃ kīrtayāścana
verses.en: I am the speaker here, not thou: speak thou where the assembly meets. Thou shalt be mine and only mine, and never mention other dames.

verses.sa:
यदि वासि तिरोजनं यदि वा नद्यऽस्तिरः ।
इयं ह मह्यं त्वामोषधिर्बद्ध्वेव न्यानयत्॥
verses.tr: yadi vāsi tirojanaṃ yadi vā nadya'stiraḥ iyaṃ ha mahyaṃ tvāmoṣadhirbaddhveva nyānayat
verses.en: If thou art far away beyond the rivers, far away from men, This Herb shall seem to bind thee fast and bring thee back my prisoner.

sections.label: A sacrificial charm for rain and prosperity
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 39

verses.sa:
दिव्यं सुपर्णं पयसं बृहन्तमपां गर्भं वृषभमोषधीनाम्।
अभीपतो वृष्ट्या तर्पयन्तमा नो गोष्ठे रयिष्ठां स्थापयाति॥
verses.tr: divyaṃ suparṇaṃ payasaṃ bṛhantamapāṃ garbhaṃ vṛṣabhamoṣadhīnām abhīpato vṛṣṭyā tarpayantamā no goṣṭhe rayiṣṭhāṃ sthāpayāti
verses.en: May he establish in our home the master of riches, gladdening with rain in season, Mighty, strong-winged, celestial, dropping moisture, Bull of the plants and embryo of waters.

sections.label: A prayer for prosperity
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 40

verses.sa:
यस्य व्रतं पशवो यन्ति सर्वे यस्य व्रत उपतिष्ठन्त आपः ।
यस्य व्रते पुष्टपतिर्निविष्टस्तं सरस्वन्तमवसे हवामहे॥
verses.tr: yasya vrataṃ paśavo yanti sarve yasya vrata upatiṣṭhanta āpaḥ yasya vrate puṣṭapatirniviṣṭastaṃ sarasvantamavase havāmahe
verses.en: We call Sarasvan, under whose protection all cattle wander, to preserve and aid us, Him in whose ordinance abide the waters, to whose command the. Lord of Plenty listens.

verses.sa:
आ प्रत्यञ्चं दाशुषे दाश्वंसं सरस्वन्तं पुष्टपतिं रयिष्ठाम्।
रायस्पोषं श्रवस्युं वसाना इह हुवेम सदनं रयीणाम्॥
verses.tr: ā pratyañcaṃ dāśuṣe dāśvaṃsaṃ sarasvantaṃ puṣṭapatiṃ rayiṣṭhām rāyaspoṣaṃ śravasyuṃ vasānā iha huvema sadanaṃ rayīṇām
verses.en: Abiding here let us invoke Sarasvan, the seat of riches, glorious, wealth-increaser, Him who inclines and gives to him who worships, the rich possessor and the Lord of Fulness.

sections.label: A prayer for prosperity
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 41

verses.sa:
अति धन्वान्यत्यपस्ततर्द श्येनो नृचक्षा अवसानदर्शः ।
तरन् विश्वान्यवरा रजांसीन्द्रेण सख्या शिव आ जगम्यात्॥
verses.tr: ati dhanvānyatyapastatarda śyeno nṛcakṣā avasānadarśaḥ taran viśvānyavarā rajāṃsīndreṇa sakhyā śiva ā jagamyāt
verses.en: Observing men, and viewing home, the Falcon hath cleft his swift way over wastes and waters. May he, with Indra for a friend, auspicious, traversing all air's lower realms, come hither.

verses.sa:
श्येनो नृचक्षा दिव्यः सुपर्णः सहस्रपाच्छतयोनिर्वयोधाः ।
स नो नि यच्छाद् वसु यत् पराभृतमस्माकमस्तु पितृषु स्वधावत्॥
verses.tr: śyeno nṛcakṣā divyaḥ suparṇaḥ sahasrapācchatayonirvayodhāḥ sa no ni yacchād vasu yat parābhṛtamasmākamastu pitṛṣu svadhāvat
verses.en: The heavenly Falcon, viewing men, well-pinioned, strength-giver, hundred-footed, hundred-nested, Shall give us treasure which was taken from us. May it be rich in food among our Fathers.

sections.label: A prayer for delivery from sin and sickness
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 42

verses.sa:
सोमारुद्रा वि वृहतं विषूचीममी वा या नो गयमाविवेश ।
बाधेथां दूरं निरृतिं पराचैः कृतं चिदेनः प्र मुमुक्तमस्मत्॥
verses.tr: somārudrā vi vṛhataṃ viṣūcīmamī vā yā no gayamāviveśa bādhethāṃ dūraṃ nirṛtiṃ parācaiḥ kṛtaṃ cidenaḥ pra mumuktamasmat
verses.en: Scatter and drive away, Soma and Rudra, the sickness that hath come within our dwelling. Afar into the distance chase Destruction, and even from committed sin release us.

verses.sa:
सोमारुद्रा युवमेतान्यस्मद् विश्वा तनूषु भेषजानि धत्तम्।
अव स्यतं मुञ्चतं यन्नो असत् तनूषु बद्धं कृतमेनो अस्मत्॥
verses.tr: somārudrā yuvametānyasmad viśvā tanūṣu bheṣajāni dhattam ava syataṃ muñcataṃ yanno asat tanūṣu baddhaṃ kṛtameno asmat
verses.en: Lay on our bodies, O ye twain, O Soma and Rudra, all those balms that heal diseases. Set free and draw away the sin committed, which we have still inherent in our persons.

sections.label: A charm against lightning
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 43

verses.sa:
शिवास्त एका अशिवास्त एकाः सर्वा बिभर्षि सुमनस्यमानः ।
तिस्रो वाचो निहिता अन्तरस्मिन् तासामेका वि पपातानु घोषम्॥
verses.tr: śivāsta ekā aśivāsta ekāḥ sarvā bibharṣi sumanasyamānaḥ tisro vāco nihitā antarasmin tāsāmekā vi papātānu ghoṣam
verses.en: Some of thy words bode weal and some misfortune: thou scatterest them all with friendly feeling. Deep within this three words are laid: r among them one hath flown off even as the sound was uttered.

sections.label: In praise of Indra and Vishnu
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 44

verses.sa:
उभा जिग्यथुर्न परा जयेथे न परा जिग्ये कतरश्चनैनयोः ।
इन्द्रश्च विष्णो यदपस्पृधेथां त्रेधा सहस्रं वि तदैरयेथाम्॥
verses.tr: ubhā jigyathurna parā jayethe na parā jigye kataraścanainayoḥ indraśca viṣṇo yadapaspṛdhethāṃ tredhā sahasraṃ vi tadairayethām
verses.en: Ye twain have conquered, and have not been vanquished: not either of the pair hath been defeated. Ye, Indra Vishnu, when ye fought your battle; produced this infinite with three divisions,

sections.label: Eee cee - A charm against jealousy aks
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 45

verses.sa:
जनाद् विश्वजनीनात् सिन्धुतस्पर्याभृतम्।
दूरात् त्वा मन्य उद्भृतमीर्ष्याया नाम भेषजम्॥
verses.tr: janād viśvajanīnāt sindhutasparyābhṛtam dūrāt tvā manya udbhṛtamīrṣyāyā nāma bheṣajam
verses.en: Brought hitherward from Sindhu, from a folk of every mingled race, Fetched from afar, thou art I deem, a balm that cureth jealousy.

verses.sa:
अग्नेरिवास्य दहतो दावस्य दहतः पृथक्।
एतामेतस्येर्ष्यामुद्राग्निमिव शमय॥
verses.tr: agnerivāsya dahato dāvasya dahataḥ pṛthak etāmetasyerṣyāmudrāgnimiva śamaya
verses.en: As one with water quencheth fire, so calm this lover's jealousy, Like heat of fire that burneth here, or flame that rageth through the wood.

sections.label: A charm for offspring and prosperity
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 46

verses.sa:
सिनीवालि पृथुष्टुके या देवानामसि स्वसा ।
जुषस्व हव्यमाहुतं प्रजां देवि दिदिड्ढि नः॥
verses.tr: sinīvāli pṛthuṣṭuke yā devānāmasi svasā juṣasva havyamāhutaṃ prajāṃ devi didiḍḍhi naḥ
verses.en: O Broad-tressed Sinivali, thou who art the sister of the Gods, Accept the offered sacrifice, and, Goddess, grant us progeny. "In praise of Indra and Vishnu. This infinite with three divisions: the vast world with all its creatures; the three divisions are heaven, firmament, and earth.

verses.sa:
या सुबाहुः स्वङ्गुरिः सुषूमा बहुसूवरी ।
तस्यै विश्पत्न्यै हविः सिनीवाल्यै जुहोतन॥
verses.tr: yā subāhuḥ svaṅguriḥ suṣūmā bahusūvarī tasyai viśpatnyai haviḥ sinīvālyai juhotana
verses.en: Present the sacrifice to her, to Sinivali, Queen of men, Beautiful-fingered, lovely-armed, prolific, bearing many a child.

verses.sa:
या विश्पत्नीन्द्रमसि प्रतीची सहस्रस्तुकाभियन्ती देवी।
विष्णोः पत्नि तुभ्यं राता हवींषि पतिं देवि राधसे चोदयस्व॥
verses.tr: yā viśpatnīndramasi pratīcī sahasrastukābhiyantī devī viṣṇoḥ patni tubhyaṃ rātā havīṃṣi patiṃ devi rādhase codayasva
verses.en: Thou who as Queen of men art Indra's equal, a Goddess coming with a thousand tresses, To thee our sacrifices are performed, O Consort of Vishnu: Goddess, urge thy Lord to bounty!

sections.label: A prayer for wealth and the birth of a son
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 47

verses.sa:
कुहूं देवीं सुकृतं विद्मनापसमस्मिन् यज्ञे सुहवा जोहवीमि ।
सा नो रयिं विश्ववारं नि यच्छाद् ददातु वीरं शतदायमुक्थ्यऽम्॥
verses.tr: kuhūṃ devīṃ sukṛtaṃ vidmanāpasamasmin yajñe suhavā johavīmi sā no rayiṃ viśvavāraṃ ni yacchād dadātu vīraṃ śatadāyamukthya'm
verses.en: Oft in this sacrifice with favoured cry I call Kuh, beneficent Goddess, skilled in all her works, May she vouchsafe us wealth with every boon, and give a hero meet for praise who gives a hundred gifts,

verses.sa:
कुहूर्देवानाममृतस्य पत्नी हव्या नो अस्य हविषो जुषेत ।
शृणोतु यज्ञमुशती नो अद्य रायस्पोषं चिकितुषी दधातु॥
verses.tr: kuhūrdevānāmamṛtasya patnī havyā no asya haviṣo juṣeta śṛṇotu yajñamuśatī no adya rāyaspoṣaṃ cikituṣī dadhātu
verses.en: Kuh, the Queen of Gods and immortality, called to assist, enjoy this sacrifice of ours! Let her, desirous of our worship, hear to-day: may she, intelligent, give increase of our wealth.

sections.label: A prayer for prosperity and the birth of a son
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 48

verses.sa:
राकामहं सुहवा सुष्टुती हुवे शृणोतु नः सुभगा बोधतु त्मना ।
सीव्यत्वपः सूच्याच्छिद्यमानया ददातु वीरं शतदायमुक्थ्यऽम्॥
verses.tr: rākāmahaṃ suhavā suṣṭutī huve śṛṇotu naḥ subhagā bodhatu tmanā sīvyatvapaḥ sūcyācchidyamānayā dadātu vīraṃ śatadāyamukthya'm
verses.en: I Call on Raka with fair laud and reverent cry: may she, auspicious, hear us and herself observe. With never-breaking needle may she sew her work, and send a glorious man who gives a hundred gifts.

verses.sa:
यास्ते राके सुमतयः सुपेशसो याभिर्ददासि दाशुषे वसूनि ।
ताभिर्नो अद्य सुमना उपागहि सहस्रापोषं सुभगे रराणा॥
verses.tr: yāste rāke sumatayaḥ supeśaso yābhirdadāsi dāśuṣe vasūni tābhirno adya sumanā upāgahi sahasrāpoṣaṃ subhage rarāṇā
verses.en: All thy kind favour, Rakft I lovely in their form, wherewith: thou grantest treasures to the man who gives, With. these come thou to us this day benevolent, O blessed one, bestowing wealth. of thousand sorts.

sections.label: A" prayer for children and booty
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 49

verses.sa:
देवानां पत्नीरुशतीरवन्तु नः प्रावन्तु नस्तुजये वाजसातये ।
याः पार्थिवासो या अपामपि व्रते ता नो देवीः सुहवाः शर्म यच्छन्तु॥
verses.tr: devānāṃ patnīruśatīravantu naḥ prāvantu nastujaye vājasātaye yāḥ pārthivāso yā apāmapi vrate tā no devīḥ suhavāḥ śarma yacchantu
verses.en: May the Gods' Consorts aid us of their own freewill help us to offspring and the winning of the spoil. May Goddesses who quickly listen shelter us, both those on earth and they within the waters' realm.

verses.sa:
उत ग्ना व्यन्तु देवपत्नीरिन्द्राण्य१ग्नाय्यश्विनी राट्।
आ रोदसी वरुणानी शृणोतु व्यन्तु देवीर्य ऋतुर्जनीनाम्॥
verses.tr: uta gnā vyantu devapatnīrindrāṇya1gnāyyaśvinī rāṭ ā rodasī varuṇānī śṛṇotu vyantu devīrya ṛturjanīnām
verses.en: May the Dames, wives of Gods, enjoy our presents, Rat, Asvini, Indrani, and Agnayi; May Rodasi and Varunani hear us, and Goddesses come at the matrons' season.

sections.label: A gambler's prayer for success in gaming
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 50

verses.sa:
यथा वृक्षमशनिर्विश्वाहा हन्त्यप्रति।
एवाहमद्य कितवानक्षैर्बध्यासमप्रति॥
verses.tr: yathā vṛkṣamaśanirviśvāhā hantyaprati evāhamadya kitavānakṣairbadhyāsamaprati
verses.en: As evermore the lightning flash strikes, irresistible, the tree, So, irresistible may I conquer the gamblers with the dice.

verses.sa:
तुराणामतुराणां विशामवर्जुषीणाम्।
समैतु विश्वतो भगो अन्तर्हस्तं कृतं मम॥
verses.tr: turāṇāmaturāṇāṃ viśāmavarjuṣīṇām samaitu viśvato bhago antarhastaṃ kṛtaṃ mama
verses.en: From every side, from hale and sick, impotent to defend themselves, May all the fortune of the folk as winnings pass into my hands.

verses.sa:
ईडे अग्निं स्वावसुं नमोभिरिह प्रसक्तो वि चयत् कृतं नः ।
रथैरिव प्र भरे वाजयद्भिः प्रदक्षिणं मरुतां स्तोममृध्याम्॥
verses.tr: īḍe agniṃ svāvasuṃ namobhiriha prasakto vi cayat kṛtaṃ naḥ rathairiva pra bhare vājayadbhiḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ marutāṃ stomamṛdhyām
verses.en: I pray to Agni, him who guards his treasure: here, won by homage, may he pile our winnings. As 'twere with racing cars I bring my presents: duly with reverence, let me laud the Maruts.

verses.sa:
वयं जयेम त्वया युजा वृतमस्माकमंशमुदवा भरेभरे ।
अस्मभ्यमिन्द्र वरीयः सुगं कृधि प्र शत्रूणां मघवन् वृष्ण्या रुज॥
verses.tr: vayaṃ jayema tvayā yujā vṛtamasmākamaṃśamudavā bharebhare asmabhyamindra varīyaḥ sugaṃ kṛdhi pra śatrūṇāṃ maghavan vṛṣṇyā ruja
verses.en: With thee to aid us may we win the treasure: do thou assist our side in every battle. Give us wide room and easy way, O Indra; break down, O Maghavan, the foemen's valour.

verses.sa:
अजैषं त्वा संलिखितमजैषमुत संरुधम्।
अविं वृको यथा मथदेवा मथ्नामि ते कृतम्॥
verses.tr: ajaiṣaṃ tvā saṃlikhitamajaiṣamuta saṃrudham aviṃ vṛko yathā mathadevā mathnāmi te kṛtam
verses.en: I have completely cleaned thee out, won from thee what thou keptest back. As a wolf tears and rends a sheep, so do I tear thy Stake away.

verses.sa:
उत प्रहामतिदीवा जयति कृतमिव श्वघ्नी वि चिनोति काले।
यो देवकामो न धनं रुणद्धि समित् तं रायः सृजति स्वधाभिः॥
verses.tr: uta prahāmatidīvā jayati kṛtamiva śvaghnī vi cinoti kāle yo devakāmo na dhanaṃ ruṇaddhi samit taṃ rāyaḥ sṛjati svadhābhiḥ
verses.en: Yea, by superior play one gains advantage: in time he piles his spoil as doth a gambler. He overwhelms with wealth's inherent powers the devotee who keeps not back his riches.

verses.sa:
गोभिष्टरेमामतिं दुरेवां यवेन वा क्षुधं पुरुहूत विश्वे ।
वयं राजसु प्रथमा धनान्यरिष्टासो वृजनीभिर्जयेम॥
verses.tr: gobhiṣṭaremāmatiṃ durevāṃ yavena vā kṣudhaṃ puruhūta viśve vayaṃ rājasu prathamā dhanānyariṣṭāso vṛjanībhirjayema
verses.en: May we all, much-invoked! repel with cattle want that brings sin, hunger with store of barley. May we uninjured, first among the princes, obtain possessions by our own exertions.

verses.sa:
कृतं मे दक्षिणे हस्ते जयो मे सव्य आहितः ।
गोजिद् भूयासमश्वजिद् धनंजयो हिरण्यजित्॥
verses.tr: kṛtaṃ me dakṣiṇe haste jayo me savya āhitaḥ gojid bhūyāsamaśvajid dhanaṃjayo hiraṇyajit
verses.en: My right hand holds my winnings fast, and in my left is victory. I would that I were winner of cattle and horses, wealth and gold.

verses.sa:
अक्षाः फलवतीं द्युवं दत्त गां क्षीरिणीमिव ।
सं मा कृतस्य धारया धनुः स्नाव्नेव नह्यत॥
verses.tr: akṣāḥ phalavatīṃ dyuvaṃ datta gāṃ kṣīriṇīmiva saṃ mā kṛtasya dhārayā dhanuḥ snāvneva nahyata
verses.en: Dice, give me play that bringeth fruit as 'twere a cow with flowing milk! And, as the bowstring binds the bow, unite me with a stream of gains.

sections.label: A prayer for Brihaspati's and Indra's protection
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 51

verses.sa:
बृहस्पतिर्नः परि पातु पश्चादुतोत्तरस्मादधरादघायोः ।
इन्द्रः पुरस्तादुत मध्यतो नः सखा सखिभ्यो वरीयः कृणोतु॥
verses.tr: bṛhaspatirnaḥ pari pātu paścādutottarasmādadharādaghāyoḥ indraḥ purastāduta madhyato naḥ sakhā sakhibhyo varīyaḥ kṛṇotu
verses.en: Brihaspati protect us from the sinner, from rearward, from above, and from below us! May Indra from the front and from the centre, as friend to friends, vouchsafe us room and freedom.

sections.label: A prayer for peace and concord
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 52

verses.sa:
संज्ञानं नः स्वेभिः संज्ञानमरणेभिः ।
संज्ञानमश्विना युवमिहास्मासु नि यच्छतम्॥
verses.tr: saṃjñānaṃ naḥ svebhiḥ saṃjñānamaraṇebhiḥ saṃjñānamaśvinā yuvamihāsmāsu ni yacchatam
verses.en: Give us agreement with our own, with strangers give us unity: Do ye, O Asvins, in this place join us in sympathy and love.

verses.sa:
सं जानामहै मनसा सं चिकित्वा मा युष्महि मनसा दैव्येन ।
मा घोषा उत् स्थुर्बहुले विनिर्हते मेषुः पप्तदिन्द्रस्याहन्यागते॥
verses.tr: saṃ jānāmahai manasā saṃ cikitvā mā yuṣmahi manasā daivyena mā ghoṣā ut sthurbahule vinirhate meṣuḥ paptadindrasyāhanyāgate
verses.en: May we agree in mind, agree in purpose: let us not fight against the heavenly spirit. Around us rise no din of frequent slaughter, nor Indra's arrow fly, for day is present!

sections.label: A charm to recover a sick man at the point of death
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 53

verses.sa:
अमुत्रभूयादधि यद् यमस्य बृहस्पतेरभिशस्तेरमुञ्चः ।
प्रत्यौहतामश्विना मृत्युमस्मद् देवानामग्ने भिषजा शचीभिः॥
verses.tr: amutrabhūyādadhi yad yamasya bṛhaspaterabhiśasteramuñcaḥ pratyauhatāmaśvinā mṛtyumasmad devānāmagne bhiṣajā śacībhiḥ
verses.en: As thou, Brihaspati, from the curse hast saved us, from dwelling yonder in the realm of Yama, The Asvins, leeches of the Gods, O Agni, have chased Death far from us with mighty powers.

verses.sa:
सं क्रामतं मा जहीतं शरीरं प्राणापानौ ते सयुजाविह स्ताम्।
शतं जीव शरदो वर्धमानोऽग्निष्टे गोपा अधिपा वसिष्ठः॥
verses.tr: saṃ krāmataṃ mā jahītaṃ śarīraṃ prāṇāpānau te sayujāviha stām śataṃ jīva śarado vardhamāno'gniṣṭe gopā adhipā vasiṣṭhaḥ
verses.en: Move both together; do not leave the body. Let both the breathings stay for thee united. Waxing in strength live thou a hundred autumns. Thy noblest guardian and thy lord is Agni.

verses.sa:
आयुर्यत् ते अतिहितं पराचैरपानः प्राणः पुनरा ताविताम्।
अग्निष्टदाहार्निरृतेरुपस्थात् तदात्मनि पुनरा वेशयामि ते॥
verses.tr: āyuryat te atihitaṃ parācairapānaḥ prāṇaḥ punarā tāvitām agniṣṭadāhārnirṛterupasthāt tadātmani punarā veśayāmi te
verses.en: Return, thy life now vanished into distance! Return, the breath thou drawest and exhaust! Agni hath snatched it from Destruction's bosom; into thyself again I introduce it.

verses.sa:
मेमं प्राणो हासीन्मो अपानोऽवहाय परा गात्।
सप्तर्षिभ्य एनं परि ददामि त एनं स्वस्ति जरसे वहन्तु॥
verses.tr: memaṃ prāṇo hāsīnmo apāno'vahāya parā gāt saptarṣibhya enaṃ pari dadāmi ta enaṃ svasti jarase vahantu
verses.en: Let not the vital breath he draws forsake him, let not his expiration part and leave him. I give him over to the Seven Rishis: let them conduct him to old age in safety.

verses.sa:
प्र विशतं प्राणापानावनड्वाहाविव व्रजम्।
अयं जरिम्णः शेवधिररिष्ट इह वर्धताम्॥
verses.tr: pra viśataṃ prāṇāpānāvanaḍvāhāviva vrajam ayaṃ jarimṇaḥ śevadhirariṣṭa iha vardhatām
verses.en: Enter him, both ye breaths, like two draught-oxen entering their stall. Let him, the treasure of old age, still wax in strength, uninjured, here.

verses.sa:
आ ते प्राणं सुवामसि परा यक्ष्मं सुवामि ते ।
आयुर्नो विश्वतो दधदयमग्निर्वरेण्यः॥
verses.tr: ā te prāṇaṃ suvāmasi parā yakṣmaṃ suvāmi te āyurno viśvato dadhadayamagnirvareṇyaḥ
verses.en: I send thee back thy vital breath; I drive Consumption far from thee. May Agni here, most excellent, sustain our life on every side.

verses.sa:
उद् वयं तमसस्परि रोहन्तो नाकमुत्तमम्।
देवं देवत्रा सूर्यमगन्म ज्योतिरुत्तमम्॥
verses.tr: ud vayaṃ tamasaspari rohanto nākamuttamam devaṃ devatrā sūryamaganma jyotiruttamam
verses.en: From out the depth of darkness, we, ascending to the highest heaven, Have come to the sublimest light, to Surya, God among the Gods.

sections.label: A charm to obtain knowledge of the Veda
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 54

verses.sa:
ऋचं साम यजामहे याभ्यां कर्माणि कुर्वते ।
एते सदसि राजतो यज्ञं देवेषु यच्छतः॥
verses.tr: ṛcaṃ sāma yajāmahe yābhyāṃ karmāṇi kurvate ete sadasi rājato yajñaṃ deveṣu yacchataḥ
verses.en: We worship holy Verse and Song, by which they carry out their acts. Shining in Order's seat these twain present the sacrifice to Gods.

verses.sa:
ऋचं साम यदप्राक्षं हविरोजो यजुर्बलम्।
एष मा तस्मान्मा हिंसीद् वेदः पृष्टः शचीपते॥
verses.tr: ṛcaṃ sāma yadaprākṣaṃ havirojo yajurbalam eṣa mā tasmānmā hiṃsīd vedaḥ pṛṣṭaḥ śacīpate
verses.en: As I have asked about Verse, Song, Sacrifice, strength, force, Yajus-text, So never let this lore that I have sought forsake me, Lord of Might!

sections.label: A charm to ensure a prosperous journey
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 55

verses.sa:
ये ते पन्थानोऽव दिवो येभिर्विश्वमैरयः ।
तेभिः सुम्नया धेहि नो वसो॥
verses.tr: ye te panthāno'va divo yebhirviśvamairayaḥ tebhiḥ sumnayā dhehi no vaso
verses.en: Thy downward paths from heaven, whereby thou hast raised all the world to life, Give us in gracious love, good Lord!

sections.label: A charm against poisonous bites and stings
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 56

verses.sa:
तिरश्चिराजेरसितात् पृदाकोः परि संभृतम्।
तत् कङ्कपर्वणो विषमियं वीरुदनीनशत्॥
verses.tr: tiraścirājerasitāt pṛdākoḥ pari saṃbhṛtam tat kaṅkaparvaṇo viṣamiyaṃ vīrudanīnaśat
verses.en: Whether it came from viper, from black snake or snake with transverse stripes, Or Kankaparvan's bite, this herb hath made the poison powerless.

verses.sa:
इयं वीरुन्मधुजाता मधुश्चुन्मधुला मधूः ।
सा विह्रुतस्य भेषज्यथो मशकजम्भनी॥
verses.tr: iyaṃ vīrunmadhujātā madhuścunmadhulā madhūḥ sā vihrutasya bheṣajyatho maśakajambhanī
verses.en: Honey-born, honey-dropping, rich in honey, honey-sweet, this her Is medicine that heals the wound and kills the gnat that bites and stings.

verses.sa:
यतो दष्टं यतो धीतं ततस्ते निर्ह्वयामसि ।
अर्भस्य तृप्रदंशिनो मशकस्यारसं विषम्॥
verses.tr: yato daṣṭaṃ yato dhītaṃ tataste nirhvayāmasi arbhasya tṛpradaṃśino maśakasyārasaṃ viṣam
verses.en: Whatever bit, or sucked thy blood, we summon thence away from thee The ineffectual poison of the little sharply-stinging gnat.

verses.sa:
अयं यो वक्रो विपरुर्व्यऽङ्गो मुखानि वक्रा वृजिना कृणोषि ।
तानि त्वं ब्रह्मणस्पत इषीकामिव सं नमः॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ yo vakro viparurvya'ṅgo mukhāni vakrā vṛjinā kṛṇoṣi tāni tvaṃ brahmaṇaspata iṣīkāmiva saṃ namaḥ
verses.en: Thou here who crookest wicked jaws, thou tortuous, jointless, limbless thing, These jaws thou, Brahmanaspati! shalt bend together like a reed.

verses.sa:
अरसस्य शर्कोटस्य नीचीनस्योपसर्पतः ।
विषं ह्य१स्यादिष्यथो एनमजीजभम्॥
verses.tr: arasasya śarkoṭasya nīcīnasyopasarpataḥ viṣaṃ hya1syādiṣyatho enamajījabham
verses.en: This scorpion here that creeps along, low on the ground and powerless—I have removed his poison and then utterly demolished him.

verses.sa:
न ते बाह्वोर्बलमस्ति न शीर्षे नोत मध्यतः ।
अथ किं पापयामुया पुच्छे बिभर्ष्यर्भकम्॥
verses.tr: na te bāhvorbalamasti na śīrṣe nota madhyataḥ atha kiṃ pāpayāmuyā pucche bibharṣyarbhakam
verses.en: No strength in thy two arms hast thou, nor in thy head, nor in thy waist: Then what is that small thing thou so viciously bearest in thy tail?

verses.sa:
अदन्ति त्वा पिपीलिका वि वृश्चन्ति मयूर्यः ।
सर्वे भल ब्रवाथ शार्कोटमरसं विषम्॥
verses.tr: adanti tvā pipīlikā vi vṛścanti mayūryaḥ sarve bhala bravātha śārkoṭamarasaṃ viṣam
verses.en: The emmets make a meal of thee and peahens tear and mangle thee: All ye are crying out, In sooth the scorpion's poison hath no strength.

verses.sa:
य उभाभ्यां प्रहरसि पुच्छेन चास्येऽन च ।
आस्ये३ न ते विषं किमु ते पुच्छधावसत्॥
verses.tr: ya ubhābhyāṃ praharasi pucchena cāsye'na ca āsye3 na te viṣaṃ kimu te pucchadhāvasat
verses.en: Thou creature who inflietest wounds both with thy mouth and with thy tail, No poison in thy mouth hast thou: what at thy tail's root will there be?

sections.label: A charm for some physical disorder
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 57

verses.sa:
यदाशसा वदतो मे विचुक्षुभे यद् याचमानस्य चरतो जनाँ अनु ।
यदात्मनि तन्वोऽमे विरिष्टं सरस्वती तदा पृणद् घृतेन॥
verses.tr: yadāśasā vadato me vicukṣubhe yad yācamānasya carato janāṃ anu yadātmani tanvo'me viriṣṭaṃ sarasvatī tadā pṛṇad ghṛtena
verses.en: Whatever trouble hath disturbed and shaken me—I speak with hope, I move, imploring, 'mid the folk—What harm my body in myself hath suffered, now let Sarasvati relieve with fatness.

verses.sa:
सप्त क्षरन्ति शिशवे मरुत्वते पित्रे पुत्रासो अप्यवीवृतन्नृतानि ।
उभे इदस्योभे अस्य राजत उभे यतेते उभे अस्य पुष्यतः॥
verses.tr: sapta kṣaranti śiśave marutvate pitre putrāso apyavīvṛtannṛtāni ubhe idasyobhe asya rājata ubhe yatete ubhe asya puṣyataḥ
verses.en: Seven flow for him, the youth on whom the Maruts wait: the sons have taught the Father everlasting laws. Both worlds are his: both shine belonging unto him. Both move together: both, as his possession, thrive.

sections.label: An invitation to Indra and Varuna
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 58

verses.sa:
इन्द्रावरुणा सुतपाविमं सुतं सोमं पिबतं मद्यं धृतव्रतौ ।
युवो रथो अध्वरो देववीतये प्रति स्वसरमुप यातु पीतये॥
verses.tr: indrāvaruṇā sutapāvimaṃ sutaṃ somaṃ pibataṃ madyaṃ dhṛtavratau yuvo ratho adhvaro devavītaye prati svasaramupa yātu pītaye
verses.en: True to laws, Indra Varuna, drinkers of the juice, quaff this pressed Soma which shall give you rapturous joy! Let sacrifice, your car, to entertain the Gods, approach its resting-place that they may drink thereof.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रावरुणा मधुमत्तमस्य वृष्णः सोमस्य वृषणा वृषेथाम्।
इदं वामन्धः परिषिक्तमासद्यास्मिन् बर्हिषि मादयेथाम्॥
verses.tr: indrāvaruṇā madhumattamasya vṛṣṇaḥ somasya vṛṣaṇā vṛṣethām idaṃ vāmandhaḥ pariṣiktamāsadyāsmin barhiṣi mādayethām
verses.en: O Indra Varuna, drink your fill, ye heroes, of this effectual and sweetest Soma. This juice was shed by us that ye might quaff it. On this trimmed grass be seated and rejoice you.

sections.label: An imprecation
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 59

verses.sa:
यो नः शपादशपतः शपतो यश्च नः शपात्।
वृक्ष इव विद्युता हत आ मूलादनु शुष्यतु॥
verses.tr: yo naḥ śapādaśapataḥ śapato yaśca naḥ śapāt vṛkṣa iva vidyutā hata ā mūlādanu śuṣyatu
verses.en: Like a tree struck by lightning may the man be withered from the root, Who curseth us who curse not him, or, when we curse him, curseth us.

sections.label: A parting traveller's address to the houses of his village
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 60

verses.sa:
ऊर्जं बिभ्रद् वसुवनिः सुमेधा अघोरेण चक्षुषा मित्रियेण ।
गृहानैमि सुमना वन्दमानो रमध्वं मा बिभीत मत्॥
verses.tr: ūrjaṃ bibhrad vasuvaniḥ sumedhā aghoreṇa cakṣuṣā mitriyeṇa gṛhānaimi sumanā vandamāno ramadhvaṃ mā bibhīta mat
verses.en: I, Prudent, bringing power, a treasure-winner, with amicable eye that strikes no terror, Come, praising and kind-thoughted, to these houses: be not afraid of me, be glad and joyful.

verses.sa:
इमे गृहा मयोभुव ऊर्जस्वन्तः पयस्वन्तः ।
पूर्णा वामेन तिष्ठन्तस्ते नो जानन्त्वायतः॥
verses.tr: ime gṛhā mayobhuva ūrjasvantaḥ payasvantaḥ pūrṇā vāmena tiṣṭhantaste no jānantvāyataḥ
verses.en: Let these delightful Houses that are rich in power and store of milk, Replete with wealth and standing firm, become aware of our approach.

verses.sa:
येषामध्येति प्रवसन् येषु सौमनसो बहुः ।
गृहानुप ह्वयामहे ते नो जानन्त्वायतः॥
verses.tr: yeṣāmadhyeti pravasan yeṣu saumanaso bahuḥ gṛhānupa hvayāmahe te no jānantvāyataḥ
verses.en: These Houses we invoke, whereon the distant exile sets his thought, Wherein dwells many a friendly heart: let them be ware of our approach.

verses.sa:
उपहूता भूरिधनाः सखायः स्वादुसंमुदः ।
अक्षुध्या अतृष्या स्त गृहा मास्मद् बिभीतन॥
verses.tr: upahūtā bhūridhanāḥ sakhāyaḥ svādusaṃmudaḥ akṣudhyā atṛṣyā sta gṛhā māsmad bibhītana
verses.en: Thus greeted, ye of ample wealth, friends who enjoy delightful sweets, Be ever free from hunger, free from thirst! Ye Houses, fear us not.

verses.sa:
उपहूता इह गाव उपहूता अजावयः ।
अथो अन्नस्य कीलाल उपहूतो गृहेषु नः॥
verses.tr: upahūtā iha gāva upahūtā ajāvayaḥ atho annasya kīlāla upahūto gṛheṣu naḥ
verses.en: Kind greeting to the cattle here, kind greeting to the goats and sheep! Then, of the food within our homes, kind greeting to the pleasant drink!

verses.sa:
सूनृतावन्तः सुभगा इरावन्तो हसामुदाः ।
अतृष्या अक्षुध्या स्त गृहा मास्मद् बिभीतन॥
verses.tr: sūnṛtāvantaḥ subhagā irāvanto hasāmudāḥ atṛṣyā akṣudhyā sta gṛhā māsmad bibhītana
verses.en: Full of refreshment, full of charms, of laughter and felicity, Be ever free from hunger, free from thirst! Ye Houses, fear us not.

verses.sa:
इहैव स्त मानु गात विश्वा रूपाणि पुष्यत ।
ऐष्यामि भद्रेणा सह भूयांसो भवता मया॥
verses.tr: ihaiva sta mānu gāta viśvā rūpāṇi puṣyata aiṣyāmi bhadreṇā saha bhūyāṃso bhavatā mayā
verses.en: Stay here, and come not after me: prosper in every form and shape. With happy fortune will I come. Grow more abundant still through me! o

sections.label: A prayer for sacred knowledge and its fruits
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 61

verses.sa:
यदग्ने तपसा तप उपतप्यामहे तपः ।
प्रियाः श्रुतस्य भूयास्मायुष्मन्तः सुमेधसः॥
verses.tr: yadagne tapasā tapa upatapyāmahe tapaḥ priyāḥ śrutasya bhūyāsmāyuṣmantaḥ sumedhasaḥ
verses.en: Since, Agni, with our fervent zeal we undergo austerity, May we be dear to Sacred Lore, may we be wise and live long lives.

verses.sa:
अग्ने तपस्तप्यामह उप तप्यामहे तपः ।
श्रुतानि शृण्वन्तो वयमायुष्मन्तः सुमेधसः॥
verses.tr: agne tapastapyāmaha upa tapyāmahe tapaḥ śrutāni śṛṇvanto vayamāyuṣmantaḥ sumedhasaḥ
verses.en: Agni, we practise acts austere, we undergo austerity. So listening to Holy Lore may we grow wise and full of days.

sections.label: A prayer for the overthrow of enemies
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 62

verses.sa:
अयमग्निः सत्पतिर्वृद्धवृष्णो रथीव पत्तीनजयत् पुरोहितः ।
नाभा पृथिव्यां निहितो दविद्युतदधस्पदं कृणुतां ये पृतन्यवः॥
verses.tr: ayamagniḥ satpatirvṛddhavṛṣṇo rathīva pattīnajayat purohitaḥ nābhā pṛthivyāṃ nihito davidyutadadhaspadaṃ kṛṇutāṃ ye pṛtanyavaḥ
verses.en: Like a car-warrior, Agni here, grown mighty, Lord of the brave, Chief Priest, hath conquered footmen. Laid on earth's centre he hath flashed and glittered. Low may he lay our enemies beneath us.

sections.label: A prayer for deliverance from affliction
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 63

verses.sa:
पृतनाजितं सहमानमग्निमुक्थ्यैर्हवामहे परमात् सधस्थात्।
स नः पर्षदति दुर्गाणि विश्वा क्षामद् देवोऽति दुरितान्यग्निः॥
verses.tr: pṛtanājitaṃ sahamānamagnimukthyairhavāmahe paramāt sadhasthāt sa naḥ parṣadati durgāṇi viśvā kṣāmad devo'ti duritānyagniḥ
verses.en: We call with lauds from his most lofty dwelling victorious Agni, conqueror in battles. May he convey us over all distresses, may the God Agni bear us past our troubles.

sections.label: A charm to avert an evil omen
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 64

verses.sa:
इदं यत् कृष्णः शकुनिरभिनिष्पतन्नपीपतत्।
आपो मा तस्मात् सर्वस्माद् दुरितात् पान्त्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: idaṃ yat kṛṣṇaḥ śakunirabhiniṣpatannapīpatat āpo mā tasmāt sarvasmād duritāt pāntvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: From all that woe and trouble may the Waters save and rescue me, Whatever the Raven, black of hue, flying out hitherward, hath dropped.

verses.sa:
इदं यत् कृष्णः शकुनिरवामृक्षन्निरृते ते मुखेन ।
अग्निर्मा तस्मादेनसो गार्हपत्यः प्र मुञ्चतु॥
verses.tr: idaṃ yat kṛṣṇaḥ śakuniravāmṛkṣannirṛte te mukhena agnirmā tasmādenaso gārhapatyaḥ pra muñcatu
verses.en: May Agni Garhapatya save and set me free from all this guilt Which the black Raven with thy mouth, O Nirriti, hath wiped away.

sections.label: A charm against imprecation and threatened evils
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 65

verses.sa:
प्रतीचीनफलो हि त्वमपामार्ग रुरोहिथ ।
सर्वान् मच्छपथाँ अधि वरीयो यावया इतः॥
verses.tr: pratīcīnaphalo hi tvamapāmārga rurohitha sarvān macchapathāṃ adhi varīyo yāvayā itaḥ
verses.en: With retroverted fruit hast thou, O Apamarga, sprung and grown. Hence into distance most remote drive every curse away from me.

verses.sa:
यद् दुष्कृतं यच्छमलं यद् वा चेरिम पापया ।
त्वया तद् विश्वतोमुखापामार्गाप मृज्महे॥
verses.tr: yad duṣkṛtaṃ yacchamalaṃ yad vā cerima pāpayā tvayā tad viśvatomukhāpāmārgāpa mṛjmahe
verses.en: Whatever evil we have done, whatever vile or sinful act, With thee, O Apamarga, who lookest all ways, we wipe it off.

verses.sa:
श्यावदता कुनखिना बण्डेन यत् सहासिम।
अपामार्ग त्वया वयं सर्वं तदप मृज्महे॥
verses.tr: śyāvadatā kunakhinā baṇḍena yat sahāsima apāmārga tvayā vayaṃ sarvaṃ tadapa mṛjmahe
verses.en: If with the cripple we have lived, whose teeth are black and nails deformed, With thee, O Apamarga, we wipe all that ill away from us.

sections.label: A prayer to Vak
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 66

verses.sa:
यद्यन्तरिक्षे यदि वात आस यदि वृक्षेषु यदि वोलपेषु ।
यदश्रवन् पशव उद्यमानं तद् ब्राह्मणं पुनरस्मानुपैतु॥
verses.tr: yadyantarikṣe yadi vāta āsa yadi vṛkṣeṣu yadi volapeṣu yadaśravan paśava udyamānaṃ tad brāhmaṇaṃ punarasmānupaitu
verses.en: If it was in the wind or air's mid-region, if it was in the trees or in the bushes, To meet whose utterance forth streamed the cattle, may that Celestial Power again approach us.

sections.label: A priest's prayer to the Agnayo Dhishnyah
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 67

verses.sa:
पुनर्मैत्विन्द्रियं पुनरात्मा द्रविणं ब्राह्मणं च ।
पुनरग्नयो धिष्ण्या यथास्थाम कल्पयन्तामिहैव॥
verses.tr: punarmaitvindriyaṃ punarātmā draviṇaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ ca punaragnayo dhiṣṇyā yathāsthāma kalpayantāmihaiva
verses.en: May sense return to me again, and spirit, return my Sacred Power and my possessions! Again let fires, aflame on lesser altars, each duly stationed, here succeed and prosper.

sections.label: A prayer for children and prosperity
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 68

verses.sa:
सरस्वति व्रतेषु ते दिव्येषु देवि धामसु ।
जुषस्व हव्यमाहुतं प्रजां देवि ररास्व नः॥
verses.tr: sarasvati vrateṣu te divyeṣu devi dhāmasu juṣasva havyamāhutaṃ prajāṃ devi rarāsva naḥ
verses.en: Sarasvati, in thy decrees, Goddess, in thy celestial laws, Accept the offered sacrifice, and, Goddess, grant us progeny.

verses.sa:
इदं ते हव्यं घृतवत् सरस्वतीदं पितॄणां हविरास्यं१ यत्।
इमानि त उदिता शंतमानि तेभिर्वयं मधुमन्तः स्याम॥
verses.tr: idaṃ te havyaṃ ghṛtavat sarasvatīdaṃ pitṝṇāṃ havirāsyaṃ1 yat imāni ta uditā śaṃtamāni tebhirvayaṃ madhumantaḥ syāma
verses.en: Here is, Sarasvati, thy fat libation, this sacrifice passing to the mouth of Fathers. These most auspicious offerings have ascended to thee: through these may we be full of sweetness.

verses.sa:
शिवा नः शंतमा भव सुमृडीका सरस्वति ।
मा ते युयोम संदृशः॥
verses.tr: śivā naḥ śaṃtamā bhava sumṛḍīkā sarasvati mā te yuyoma saṃdṛśaḥ
verses.en: Be kind and most auspicious, be gracious to us, Sarasvati. May we be ever in thy sight.

sections.label: A prayer for prosperity
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 69

verses.sa:
शं नो वातो वातु शं नस्तपतु सूर्यः ।
अहानि शं भवन्तु नः शं रात्री प्रति धीयतां
शमुषा नो व्युऽच्छतु॥
verses.tr: śaṃ no vāto vātu śaṃ nastapatu sūryaḥ ahāni śaṃ bhavantu naḥ śaṃ rātrī prati dhīyatāṃ śamuṣā no vyu'cchatu
verses.en: May the wind kindly breathe on us, may the Sun warm us pleasantly. May days pass happily for us, may night draw near delightfully, may dawn break joyfully for us!

sections.label: A charm to frustrate an enemy's sacrifice
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 70

verses.sa:
यत् किं चासौ मनसा यच्च वाचा यज्ञैर्जुहोति हविषा यजुषा ।
तन्मृत्युना निरृतिः संविदाना पुरा सत्यादाहुतिं हन्त्वस्य॥
verses.tr: yat kiṃ cāsau manasā yacca vācā yajñairjuhoti haviṣā yajuṣā tanmṛtyunā nirṛtiḥ saṃvidānā purā satyādāhutiṃ hantvasya
verses.en: Whatever sacrifice that man performeth with voice, mind, sacred formula, oblation, May, in accord with Death, Destruction ruin his offering before it gain fulfilment.

verses.sa:
यातुधाना निरृतिरादु रक्षस्ते अस्य घ्नन्त्वनृतेन सत्यम्।
इन्द्रेषिता देवा आज्यमस्य मथ्नन्तु मा तत् सं पादि यदसौ जुहोति॥
verses.tr: yātudhānā nirṛtirādu rakṣaste asya ghnantvanṛtena satyam indreṣitā devā ājyamasya mathnantu mā tat saṃ pādi yadasau juhoti
verses.en: For him may sorcerers, Destruction, demons strike and prevent fulfilment through their falsehood. Let Gods, by Indra sent, destroy his butter, and let his sacrifice be ineffective.

verses.sa:
अजिराधिराजौ श्येनौ संपातिनाविव ।
आज्यं पृतन्यतो हतां यो नः कश्चाभ्यघायति॥
verses.tr: ajirādhirājau śyenau saṃpātināviva ājyaṃ pṛtanyato hatāṃ yo naḥ kaścābhyaghāyati
verses.en: Let the two Sovrans, swift to come, like falcons swooping on their prey, Destroy the butter of the foe whoever plots to injure us.

verses.sa:
अपाञ्चौ त उभौ बाहू अपि नह्याम्यास्यऽम्।
अग्नेर्देवस्य मन्युना तेन तेऽवधिषं हविः॥
verses.tr: apāñcau ta ubhau bāhū api nahyāmyāsya'm agnerdevasya manyunā tena te'vadhiṣaṃ haviḥ
verses.en: I seize thine arms and draw them back, I bind a bandage on thy mouth. I with the anger of the God Agni have killed thy sacrifice.

verses.sa:
अपि नह्यामि ते बाहू अपि नह्याम्यास्यऽम्।
अग्नेर्घोरस्य मन्युना तेन तेऽवधिषं हविः॥
verses.tr: api nahyāmi te bāhū api nahyāmyāsya'm agnerghorasya manyunā tena te'vadhiṣaṃ haviḥ
verses.en: Behind thy back I tie thine arms, I bind a bandage on thy mouth: "With the terrific Agni's wrath have I destroyed thy sacrifice.

sections.label: In praise of Agni
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 71

verses.sa:
परि त्वाग्ने पुरं वयं विप्रं सहस्य धीमहि ।
धृषद् वर्णं दिवेदिवे हन्तारं भङ्गुरावतः॥
verses.tr: pari tvāgne puraṃ vayaṃ vipraṃ sahasya dhīmahi dhṛṣad varṇaṃ divedive hantāraṃ bhaṅgurāvataḥ
verses.en: We set thee round us as a fort, victorious Agni! thee a sage, Bold in thy colour day by day, destroyer of the treacherous foe.

sections.label: An invitation to Indra
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 72

verses.sa:
उत् तिष्ठताव पश्यतेन्द्रस्य भागमृत्वियम्।
यदि श्रातं जुहोतन यद्यश्रातं ममत्तन॥
verses.tr: ut tiṣṭhatāva paśyatendrasya bhāgamṛtviyam yadi śrātaṃ juhotana yadyaśrātaṃ mamattana
verses.en: Rise up and look upon the share of Indra fixt by ritual use. Whether ye poured libation dressed or took delight in it uncooked.

verses.sa:
श्रातं हविरो ष्विन्द्र प्र याहि जगाम सूरो अध्वनो वि मध्यम्।
परि त्वासते निधिभिः सखायः कुलपा न व्राजपतिं चरन्तम्॥
verses.tr: śrātaṃ haviro ṣvindra pra yāhi jagāma sūro adhvano vi madhyam pari tvāsate nidhibhiḥ sakhāyaḥ kulapā na vrājapatiṃ carantam
verses.en: Libation is prepared. Come to us, Indra: the Sun hath travelled over half his journey. Friends with their treasures sit around thee, waiting like heads of houses for their wandering chieftain.

verses.sa:
श्रातं मन्य ऊधनि श्रातमग्नौ सुशृतं मन्ये तदृतं नवीयः ।
माध्यन्दिनस्य सवनस्य दध्नः पिबेन्द्र वज्रिन् पुरुकृज्जुषाणः॥
verses.tr: śrātaṃ manya ūdhani śrātamagnau suśṛtaṃ manye tadṛtaṃ navīyaḥ mādhyandinasya savanasya dadhnaḥ pibendra vajrin purukṛjjuṣāṇaḥ
verses.en: Dressed in the udder and on fire, I fancy; well dressed, I fancy, is this new oblation. Quaff thickened milk of noon's libation, Indra, well pleased, O Thunderer, famed for many an exploit!

sections.label: An invitation to the Asvins
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 73

verses.sa:
समिद्धो अग्निर्वृषणा रथी दिवस्तप्तो घर्मो दुह्यते वामिषे मधु ।
वयं हि वां पुरुदमासो अश्विना हवामहे सधमादेषु कारवः॥
verses.tr: samiddho agnirvṛṣaṇā rathī divastapto gharmo duhyate vāmiṣe madhu vayaṃ hi vāṃ purudamāso aśvinā havāmahe sadhamādeṣu kāravaḥ
verses.en: Inflamed is Agni, Heroes! charioteer of heaven. The caldron boils: the meath is drained to be your food. In praise of Agni. For we, O Asvins, singers sprung from many a house, invite you to be present at our banquetings.

verses.sa:
समिद्धो अग्निरश्विना तप्तो वां घर्म आ गतम्।
दुह्यन्ते नूनं वृषणेह धेनवो दस्रा मदन्ति वेधसः॥
verses.tr: samiddho agniraśvinā tapto vāṃ gharma ā gatam duhyante nūnaṃ vṛṣaṇeha dhenavo dasrā madanti vedhasaḥ
verses.en: Asvins, the fire is all aglow: your caldron hath been heated; come! Here, even now, O Heroes, are the milch-kine milked. The priests, ye mighty ones! rejoice.

verses.sa:
स्वाहाकृतः शुचिर्देवेषु यज्ञो यो अश्विनोश्चमसो देवपानः ।
तमु विश्वे अमृतासो जुषाणा गन्धर्वस्य प्रत्यास्ना रिहन्ति॥
verses.tr: svāhākṛtaḥ śucirdeveṣu yajño yo aśvinoścamaso devapānaḥ tamu viśve amṛtāso juṣāṇā gandharvasya pratyāsnā rihanti
verses.en: Pure with the Gods is sacrifice with cry of Hail! That is the Asvins' cup whence Gods are wont to drink. Yea, the Immortal Ones accept it, one and all, and come to kiss that cup with the Gandharva's mouth.

verses.sa:
यदुस्रियास्वाहुतं घृतं पयोऽयं स वामश्विना भाग आ गतम्।
माध्वी धर्तारा विदथस्य सत्पती तप्तं घर्मं पिबतं रोचने दिवः॥
verses.tr: yadusriyāsvāhutaṃ ghṛtaṃ payo'yaṃ sa vāmaśvinā bhāga ā gatam mādhvī dhartārā vidathasya satpatī taptaṃ gharmaṃ pibataṃ rocane divaḥ
verses.en: Milk, molten butter offered when the mornings break,—this is your portion, Asvins! Come ye hitherward. Lords of the brave, balm-lover? guards of sacrifice, drink ye the warm libation in the light of heaven.

verses.sa:
तप्तो वां घर्मो नक्षतु स्वहोता प्र वामध्वर्युश्चरतु पयस्वान्।
मधोर्दुग्धस्याश्विना तनाया वीतं पातं पयस उस्रियायाः॥
verses.tr: tapto vāṃ gharmo nakṣatu svahotā pra vāmadhvaryuścaratu payasvān madhordugdhasyāśvinā tanāyā vītaṃ pātaṃ payasa usriyāyāḥ
verses.en: Let the warm drink approach you with its Hotar-priest: let the Adhvaryu come to you with store of milk. Come, O ye Asvins, taste the meath that hath been drained, drink of the milk provided by this radiant cow.

verses.sa:
उप द्रव पयसा गोधुगोषमा घर्मे सिञ्च पय उस्रियायाः ।
वि नाकमख्यत् सविता वरेण्योऽनुप्रयाणमुषसो वि राजति॥
verses.tr: upa drava payasā godhugoṣamā gharme siñca paya usriyāyāḥ vi nākamakhyat savitā vareṇyo'nuprayāṇamuṣaso vi rājati
verses.en: Come hither, quickly come, thou milker of the kine: into the caldron pour milk of the radiant cow. Most precious Savitar hath looked upon the heaven. After Dawn's going-forth he sends his light abroad.

verses.sa:
उप ह्वये सुदुघां धेनुमेतां सुहस्तो गोधुगुत दोहदेनाम्।
श्रेष्ठं सवं सविता साविषन्नोऽभीऽद्धो घर्मस्तदु षु प्र वोचत्॥
verses.tr: upa hvaye sudughāṃ dhenumetāṃ suhasto godhuguta dohadenām śreṣṭhaṃ savaṃ savitā sāviṣanno'bhī'ddho gharmastadu ṣu pra vocat
verses.en: I invocate this milch-cow good for milking, so that the milker, deft of hand, may milk her. ji May Savitar give goodliest stimulation. The caldron hath been warmed. Let him proclaim it.

verses.sa:
हिङ्कृण्वती वसुपत्नी वसूनां वत्समिच्छन्ती मनसा न्यागन्।
दुहामश्विभ्यां पयो अघ्न्येयं सा वर्धतां महते सौभगाय॥
verses.tr: hiṅkṛṇvatī vasupatnī vasūnāṃ vatsamicchantī manasā nyāgan duhāmaśvibhyāṃ payo aghnyeyaṃ sā vardhatāṃ mahate saubhagāya
verses.en: She, sovran of all treasures, is come hither yearning in spirit for her calf, and lowing. May this cow yield her milk for both the Asvins, and may she prosper to our great advantage.

verses.sa:
जुष्टो दमूना अतिथिर्दुरोण इमं नो यज्ञमुप याहि विद्वान्।
विश्वा अग्ने अभियुजो विहत्य शत्रूयतामा भरा भोजनानि॥
verses.tr: juṣṭo damūnā atithirduroṇa imaṃ no yajñamupa yāhi vidvān viśvā agne abhiyujo vihatya śatrūyatāmā bharā bhojanāni
verses.en: As dear house-friend, guest welcome in the dwelling, to this our sacrifice come thou who knowest. And, Agni, having scattered all assailants, bring to us the possessions of our foemen.

verses.sa:
अग्ने शर्ध महते सौभगाय तव द्युम्नान्युत्तमानि सन्तु ।
सं जास्पत्यं सुयममा कृणुष्व शत्रूयतामभि तिष्ठा महांसि॥
verses.tr: agne śardha mahate saubhagāya tava dyumnānyuttamāni santu saṃ jāspatyaṃ suyamamā kṛṇuṣva śatrūyatāmabhi tiṣṭhā mahāṃsi
verses.en: Show thyself strong for mighty bliss, O Agni! Most excellent be thine effulgent splendours! Make easy to maintain our household lordship, and overcome the might of those who hate us.

verses.sa:
सूयवसाद् भगवती हि भूया अधा वयं भगवन्तः स्याम ।
अद्धि तृणमघ्न्ये विश्वदानीं पिब शुद्धमुदकमाचरन्ती॥
verses.tr: sūyavasād bhagavatī hi bhūyā adhā vayaṃ bhagavantaḥ syāma addhi tṛṇamaghnye viśvadānīṃ piba śuddhamudakamācarantī
verses.en: Fortunate mayst thou be with goodly pasture, and may we also be exceeding wealthy. Feed on the grass, O Cow, at every season, and, coming hither, drink the limpid water.

sections.label: A charm to cure pustules or scrofulous tumours
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 74

verses.sa:
अपचितां लोहिनीनां कृष्णा मातेति शुश्रुम ।
मुनेर्देवस्य मूलेन सर्वा विध्यामि ता अहम्॥
verses.tr: apacitāṃ lohinīnāṃ kṛṣṇā māteti śuśruma munerdevasya mūlena sarvā vidhyāmi tā aham
verses.en: Black is the mother, we have heard, from whom the red-hued Pustules sprang. With the divine ascetic's root I pierce and penetrate them all.

verses.sa:
विध्याम्यासां प्रथमां विध्याम्युत मध्यमाम्।
इदं जघन्याऽमासामा च्छिनद्मि स्तुकामिव॥
verses.tr: vidhyāmyāsāṃ prathamāṃ vidhyāmyuta madhyamām idaṃ jaghanyā'māsāmā cchinadmi stukāmiva
verses.en: I pierce the foremost one of these, I perforate the middlemost, And here I cut the hindermost asunder like a lock of hair.

verses.sa:
त्वाष्ट्रेणाहं वचसा वि त ईर्ष्याममीमदम्।
अथो यो मन्युष्टे पते तमु ते शमयामसि॥
verses.tr: tvāṣṭreṇāhaṃ vacasā vi ta īrṣyāmamīmadam atho yo manyuṣṭe pate tamu te śamayāmasi
verses.en: With spell that Tvashtar sent to us I have dispelled thy jealousy. We mitigate and pacify the anger that thou feltest, Lord!

verses.sa:
व्रतेन त्वं व्रतपते समक्तो विश्वाहा सुमना दीदिहीह।
तं त्वा वयं जातवेदः समिद्धं प्रजावन्त उप सदेम सर्वे॥
verses.tr: vratena tvaṃ vratapate samakto viśvāhā sumanā dīdihīha taṃ tvā vayaṃ jātavedaḥ samiddhaṃ prajāvanta upa sadema sarve
verses.en: Lord of religious rites, by law, anointed, shine thou forth here for ever friendly-minded. So may we all with children, Jatavedas! worship and humbly wait on thee enkindled.

sections.label: A blessing on cows
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 75

verses.sa:
प्रजावतीः सूयवसे रुशन्तीः शुद्धा अपः सुप्रपाणे पिबन्तीः ।
मा व स्तेन ईशत माघशंसः परि वो रुद्रस्य हेतिर्वृणक्तु॥
verses.tr: prajāvatīḥ sūyavase ruśantīḥ śuddhā apaḥ suprapāṇe pibantīḥ mā va stena īśata māghaśaṃsaḥ pari vo rudrasya hetirvṛṇaktu
verses.en: Let not a thief or wicked man possess you: let not the dart of Rudra come anear you, Prolific, shining in the goodly pasture, drinking at pleasant pools the limpid water.

verses.sa:
पदज्ञा स्थ रमतयः संहिता विश्वनाम्नीः ।
उप मा देवीर्देवेभिरेत ।
इमं गोष्ठमिदं सदो घृतेनास्मान्त्समुक्षत॥
verses.tr: padajñā stha ramatayaḥ saṃhitā viśvanāmnīḥ upa mā devīrdevebhireta imaṃ goṣṭhamidaṃ sado ghṛtenāsmāntsamukṣata
verses.en: Ye know the place and rest content, close-gathered, called by many a name. Come to me, Goddesses, with Gods. Bedew with streams of fatness us, this cattle-pen, and all this place.

sections.label: A charm to cure scrofulous pustules
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 76

verses.sa:
आ सुस्रसः सुस्रसो असतीभ्यो असत्तराः ।
से होररसतरा लवणाद् विक्लेदीयसीः॥
verses.tr: ā susrasaḥ susraso asatībhyo asattarāḥ se horarasatarā lavaṇād vikledīyasīḥ
verses.en: Rapidly dropping, quick to drop, more evil than the evil ones, More sapless than a dried-up bone, swifter than salt to melt away: A blessing on cows.

verses.sa:
या ग्रैव्या अपचितोऽथो या उपपक्ष्याः ।
विजाम्नि या अपचितः स्वयंस्रसः॥
verses.tr: yā graivyā apacito'tho yā upapakṣyāḥ vijāmni yā apacitaḥ svayaṃsrasaḥ
verses.en: Pustules that rise upon the neck, Pustules upon the shoulder-joints, Pustules that, falling of themselves, spring up on every twofold limb:

verses.sa:
यः कीकसाः प्रशृणाति तलीद्यऽमवतिष्ठति ।
निर्हास्तं सर्वं जायान्यं यः कश्च ककुदि श्रितः॥
verses.tr: yaḥ kīkasāḥ praśṛṇāti talīdya'mavatiṣṭhati nirhāstaṃ sarvaṃ jāyānyaṃ yaḥ kaśca kakudi śritaḥ
verses.en: I have expelled and banished all Scrofula harboured in the head, And that which bores the breast-bone through, and that which settles in the sole.

verses.sa:
पक्षी जायान्यः पतति स आ विशति पूरुषम्।
तदक्षितस्य भेषजमुभयोः सुक्षतस्य च॥
verses.tr: pakṣī jāyānyaḥ patati sa ā viśati pūruṣam tadakṣitasya bheṣajamubhayoḥ sukṣatasya ca
verses.en: Scrofula flies borne on by wings: it penetrates and holds the man. Here is the cure of either kind, the chronic and the transient.

verses.sa:
विद्म वै ते जायान्य जानं यतो जायान्य जायसे ।
कथं ह तत्र त्वं हनो यस्य कृण्मो हविर्गृहे॥
verses.tr: vidma vai te jāyānya jānaṃ yato jāyānya jāyase kathaṃ ha tatra tvaṃ hano yasya kṛṇmo havirgṛhe
