verses.en: We know thine origin, Scrofula! know whence thou, Scrofula, art born. How hast thou then struck this man here, him in whose house we sacrifice?

verses.sa:
धृषत् पिब कलशे सोममिन्द्र वृत्रहा शूर समरे वसूनाम्।
माध्यन्दिने सवन आ वृषस्व रयिष्ठानो रयिमस्मासु धेहि॥
verses.tr: dhṛṣat piba kalaśe somamindra vṛtrahā śūra samare vasūnām mādhyandine savana ā vṛṣasva rayiṣṭhāno rayimasmāsu dhehi
verses.en: Boldly drink Soma from the beaker, Indra! hero in war for treasure! Vritra-slayer. M Fill thyself full at the mid-day libation: thyself possessing riches grant us riches.

sections.label: An incantation against an enemy
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 77

verses.sa:
सांतपना इदं हविर्मरुतस्तज्जुजुष्टन ।
अस्माकोती रिशादसः॥
verses.tr: sāṃtapanā idaṃ havirmarutastajjujuṣṭana asmākotī riśādasaḥ
verses.en: Ye Maruts, full of fiery heat, accept this offering brought for you To help us, ye who slay the foe.

verses.sa:
यो नो मर्तो मरुतो दुर्हृणायुस्तिरश्चित्तानि वसवो जिघांसति ।
द्रुहः पाशान् प्रति मुञ्चतां सस्तपिष्ठेन तपसा हन्तना तम्॥
verses.tr: yo no marto maruto durhṛṇāyustiraścittāni vasavo jighāṃsati druhaḥ pāśān prati muñcatāṃ sastapiṣṭhena tapasā hantanā tam
verses.en: Maruts, the man who filled with rage against us beyond our thoughts would harm us, O ye Vasus, May he be tangled in the toils of Mischief: smite ye him down with your most flaming weapon.

verses.sa:
संवत्सरीणा मरुतः स्वर्का उरुक्षयाः सगणा मानुषासः ।
ते अस्मत् पाशान् प्र मुञ्चन्त्वेनसः सांतपना मत्सरा मादयिष्णवः॥
verses.tr: saṃvatsarīṇā marutaḥ svarkā urukṣayāḥ sagaṇā mānuṣāsaḥ te asmat pāśān pra muñcantvenasaḥ sāṃtapanā matsarā mādayiṣṇavaḥ
verses.en: Each year come, friends to man, the tuneful Maruts, dwelling in spacious mansions, trooped together. Exhilarating, gladdening, full of fiery heat, may they deliver us from binding bonds of sin.

sections.label: A charm for a prince's prosperity
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 78

verses.sa:
वि ते मुञ्चामि रशनां वि योक्त्रं वि नियोजनम्।
इहैव त्वमजस्र एध्यग्ने॥
verses.tr: vi te muñcāmi raśanāṃ vi yoktraṃ vi niyojanam ihaiva tvamajasra edhyagne
verses.en: I Free thee from the cord, I loose the bond, I loose the fastening. Even here, perpetual, Agni, wax thou strong.

verses.sa:
अस्मै क्षत्राणि धारयन्तमग्ने युनज्मि त्वा ब्रह्मणा दैव्येन ।
दीदिह्य१स्मभ्यं द्रविणेह भद्रं प्रेमं वोचो हविर्दां देवतासु॥
verses.tr: asmai kṣatrāṇi dhārayantamagne yunajmi tvā brahmaṇā daivyena dīdihya1smabhyaṃ draviṇeha bhadraṃ premaṃ voco havirdāṃ devatāsu
verses.en: I with celestial prayer appoint thee, Agni, maintainer of this man in princely powers. Here brightly shine for us with wealth: declare thou to Gods this favoured giver of oblations.

sections.label: A hymn to the New Moon
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 79

verses.sa:
यत् ते देवा अकृण्वन् भागधेयममावास्ये संवसन्तो महित्वा।
तेना नो यज्ञं पिपृहि विश्ववारे रयिं नो धेहि सुभगे सुवीरम्॥
verses.tr: yat te devā akṛṇvan bhāgadheyamamāvāsye saṃvasanto mahitvā tenā no yajñaṃ pipṛhi viśvavāre rayiṃ no dhehi subhage suvīram
verses.en: Night of the New-born Moon, whatever fortune the Gods who dwell with greatness have assigned thee, Therewith fulfil our sacrifice, all-rbounteous I Blessed One, grant us wealth with manly offspring.

verses.sa:
अहमेवास्म्यमावास्या३ मामा वसन्ति सुकृतो मयीमे।
मयि देवा उभये साध्याश्चेन्द्रज्येष्ठाः समगच्छन्त सर्वे॥
verses.tr: ahamevāsmyamāvāsyā3 māmā vasanti sukṛto mayīme mayi devā ubhaye sādhyāścendrajyeṣṭhāḥ samagacchanta sarve
verses.en: Iam the New Moon's Night, the good and pious are my inhabitants, these dwell within me. In me have Gods of both the spheres, and Sadhyas, with Indra as their chief, all met together.

verses.sa:
आगन् रात्री संगमनी वसूनामूर्जं पुष्टं वस्वावेशयन्ती ।
अमावास्याऽयै हविषा विधेमोर्जं दुहाना पयसा न आगन्॥
verses.tr: āgan rātrī saṃgamanī vasūnāmūrjaṃ puṣṭaṃ vasvāveśayantī amāvāsyā'yai haviṣā vidhemorjaṃ duhānā payasā na āgan
verses.en: The Night hath come, the gatherer of treasures, bestowing strength, prosperity, and riches. To New Moon's Night let us present oblation: pouring out strength, with milk hath she come hither.

verses.sa:
अमावास्ये न त्वदेतान्यन्यो विश्वा रूपाणि परिभूर्जजान ।
यत् कामास्ते जुहुमस्तन्नो अस्तु वयं स्याम पतयो रयिणाम्॥
verses.tr: amāvāsye na tvadetānyanyo viśvā rūpāṇi paribhūrjajāna yat kāmāste juhumastanno astu vayaṃ syāma patayo rayiṇām
verses.en: Night of New Moon! ne'er hath been born another than thou embracing all these forms and natures. May we have what we longed for when we brought thee oblations: may we be the lords of riches.

sections.label: Hymn to the Pull Moon
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 80

verses.sa:
पूर्णा पश्चादुत पूर्णा पुरस्तादुन्मध्यतः पौर्णमासी जिगाय ।
तस्यां देवैः संवसन्तो महित्वा नाकस्य पृष्ठे समिषा मदेम॥
verses.tr: pūrṇā paścāduta pūrṇā purastādunmadhyataḥ paurṇamāsī jigāya tasyāṃ devaiḥ saṃvasanto mahitvā nākasya pṛṣṭhe samiṣā madema
verses.en: Full in the front, full rearward, from the middle the Full Moon's Night hath conquered in the battle. In her may we, dwelling with Gods and greatness, feast 'in the height of heaven, on strengthening viands.

verses.sa:
वृषभं वाजिनं वयं पौर्णमासं यजामहे ।
स नो ददात्वक्षितां रयिमनुपदस्वतीम्॥
verses.tr: vṛṣabhaṃ vājinaṃ vayaṃ paurṇamāsaṃ yajāmahe sa no dadātvakṣitāṃ rayimanupadasvatīm
verses.en: To him, the Full Moon's mighty Bull, we pay our solemn sacrifice. May he bestow upon us wealth unwasting, inexhaustible.

verses.sa:
प्रजापते न त्वदेतान्यन्यो विश्वा रूपाणि परिभूर्जजान ।
यत् कामास्ते जुहुमस्तन्नो अस्तु वयं स्याम पतयो रयीणाम्॥
verses.tr: prajāpate na tvadetānyanyo viśvā rūpāṇi paribhūrjajāna yat kāmāste juhumastanno astu vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām
verses.en: No one but thou, Prajapati, none beside thee, pervading, gave to all these forms their being. Grant us our hearts' desire when we invoke thee: may we have store of riches in possession.

verses.sa:
पौर्णमासी प्रथमा यज्ञियासीदह्नां रात्रीणामतिशर्वरेषु ।
ये त्वां यज्ञैर्यज्ञिये अर्धयन्त्यमी ते नाके सुकृतः प्रविष्टाः॥
verses.tr: paurṇamāsī prathamā yajñiyāsīdahnāṃ rātrīṇāmatiśarvareṣu ye tvāṃ yajñairyajñiye ardhayantyamī te nāke sukṛtaḥ praviṣṭāḥ
verses.en: First was the Full Moon meet for adoration among the days and in the nights' deep darkness, Into thy heaven, O Holy One, have entered those pious men who honour thee with worship.

sections.label: A hymn to the New Moon
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 81

verses.sa:
पूर्वापरं चरतो माययैतौ शिशू क्रीडन्तौ परि यातोऽर्णवम्।
विश्वान्यो भुवना विचष्ट ऋतूँरन्यो विदधज्जायसे नवः॥
verses.tr: pūrvāparaṃ carato māyayaitau śiśū krīḍantau pari yāto'rṇavam viśvānyo bhuvanā vicaṣṭa ṛtūṃranyo vidadhajjāyase navaḥ
verses.en: Forward and backward by their wondrous power move these two youths, disporting, round the ocean. One views all living things, and thou, the other, art born again arranging times and seasons.

verses.sa:
नवोनवो भवसि जायमानोऽह्नां केतुरुषसामेष्यग्रम्।
भागं देवेभ्यो वि दधास्यायन् प्र चन्द्रमस्तिरसे दीर्घमायुः॥
verses.tr: navonavo bhavasi jāyamāno'hnāṃ keturuṣasāmeṣyagram bhāgaṃ devebhyo vi dadhāsyāyan pra candramastirase dīrghamāyuḥ
verses.en: Thou art re-born for ever new: thou marchest, ensign of days, in forefront of the mornings. Marching thou dealest to the Gods their portion. Thou lengthenest, Moon! the days of man's existence.

verses.sa:
सोमस्यांशो युधां पतेऽनूनो नाम वा असि ।
अनूनं दर्श मा कृधि प्रजया च धनेन च॥
verses.tr: somasyāṃśo yudhāṃ pate'nūno nāma vā asi anūnaṃ darśa mā kṛdhi prajayā ca dhanena ca
verses.en: O spray of Soma, Lord of Wars! all-perfect verily art thou. Make me all-perfect, Beauteous One! in riches and in progeny.

verses.sa:
दर्शोऽसि दर्शतोऽसि समग्रोऽसि समन्तः ।
समग्रः समन्तो भूयासं गोभिरश्वैः प्रजया पशुभिर्गृहैर्धनेन॥
verses.tr: darśo'si darśato'si samagro'si samantaḥ samagraḥ samanto bhūyāsaṃ gobhiraśvaiḥ prajayā paśubhirgṛhairdhanena
verses.en: Thou art the New Moon, fair to see, thou art complete in every part. May I be perfect, fully blest in every way in steeds and kine, in children, cattle, home, and wealth.

verses.sa:
यो३ऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मस्तस्य त्वं प्राणेना प्यायस्व ।
आ वयं प्यासिषीमहि गोभिरश्वैः प्रजया पशुभिर्गृहैर्धनेन॥
verses.tr: yo3'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmastasya tvaṃ prāṇenā pyāyasva ā vayaṃ pyāsiṣīmahi gobhiraśvaiḥ prajayā paśubhirgṛhairdhanena
verses.en: Inflate thee with his vital breath who hates us and whom we detest. May we grow rich in steeds and kine, in children, cattle, houses, wealth.

verses.sa:
यं देवा अंशुमाप्याययन्ति यमक्षितमक्षिता भक्षयन्ति ।
तेनास्मानिन्द्रो वरुणो बृहस्पतिरा प्याययन्तु भुवनस्य गोपाः॥
verses.tr: yaṃ devā aṃśumāpyāyayanti yamakṣitamakṣitā bhakṣayanti tenāsmānindro varuṇo bṛhaspatirā pyāyayantu bhuvanasya gopāḥ
verses.en: With that unwasting stalk which Gods, unwasting Gods, increase and eat, May Varuna, Brihaspati, and Indra, the Lords and Guardians of the world, increase us.

sections.label: In praise of Agni
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 82

verses.sa:
अभ्यऽर्चत सुष्टुतिं गव्यमाजिमस्मासु भद्रा द्रविणानि धत्त ।
इमं यज्ञं नयत देवता नो घृतस्य धारा मधुमत् पवन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: abhya'rcata suṣṭutiṃ gavyamājimasmāsu bhadrā draviṇāni dhatta imaṃ yajñaṃ nayata devatā no ghṛtasya dhārā madhumat pavantām
verses.en: Sing with fair laud the combat for the cattle. Bestow upon us excellent possessions. Lead to the Gods the sacrifice we offer: let streams of oil flow pure and full of sweetness.

verses.sa:
मय्यग्रे अग्निं गृह्णामि सह क्षत्रेण वर्चसा बलेन ।
मयि प्रजां मय्यायुर्दधामि स्वाहा मय्यग्निम्॥
verses.tr: mayyagre agniṃ gṛhṇāmi saha kṣatreṇa varcasā balena mayi prajāṃ mayyāyurdadhāmi svāhā mayyagnim
verses.en: Agni I first appropriate with power, with splendour, and with might. I give myself children and lengthened life, with Hail! take Agni to myself.

verses.sa:
इहैवाग्ने अधि धारया रयिं मा त्वा नि क्रन् पूर्वचित्ता निकारिणः ।
क्षत्रेणाग्ने सुयममस्तु तुभ्यमुपसत्ता वर्धतां ते अनिष्टृतः॥
verses.tr: ihaivāgne adhi dhārayā rayiṃ mā tvā ni kran pūrvacittā nikāriṇaḥ kṣatreṇāgne suyamamastu tubhyamupasattā vardhatāṃ te aniṣṭṛtaḥ
verses.en: Even here do thou, O Agni, stablish wealth: let not oppressors injure thee by thinking of thee first. Light be thy task of ruling, Agni, with thy power: may he who worships thee wax strong, invincible.

verses.sa:
अन्वग्निरुषसामग्रमख्यदन्वहानि प्रथमो जातवेदाः ।
अनु सूर्य उषसो अनु रश्मीननु द्यावापृथिवी आ विवेश॥
verses.tr: anvagniruṣasāmagramakhyadanvahāni prathamo jātavedāḥ anu sūrya uṣaso anu raśmīnanu dyāvāpṛthivī ā viveśa
verses.en: Agni hath looked upon the spring of Mornings, looked on the days, the earliest Jatavedas. So, following the gleams of Morning, Surya hath entered heaven and earth as his possession.

verses.sa:
प्रत्यग्निरुषसामग्रमख्यत् प्रत्यहानि प्रथमो जातवेदाः ।
प्रति सूर्यस्य पुरुधा च रश्मीन् प्रति द्यावापृथिवी आ ततान॥
verses.tr: pratyagniruṣasāmagramakhyat pratyahāni prathamo jātavedāḥ prati sūryasya purudhā ca raśmīn prati dyāvāpṛthivī ā tatāna
verses.en: Agni hath looked upon the spring of Mornings, looked on the days, the earliest Jatavedas. So he in countless places hath extended, full against heaven and earth, the beams of Surya.

verses.sa:
घृतं ते अग्ने दिव्ये सधस्थे घृतेन त्वां मनुरद्या समिन्धे ।
घृतं ते देवीर्नप्त्य१आ वहन्तु घृतं तुभ्यं दुह्रतां गावो अग्ने॥
verses.tr: ghṛtaṃ te agne divye sadhasthe ghṛtena tvāṃ manuradyā samindhe ghṛtaṃ te devīrnaptya1ā vahantu ghṛtaṃ tubhyaṃ duhratāṃ gāvo agne
verses.en: Butter to thee in heaven thy home, O Agni! Manu this day hath kindled thee with butter. Let the Celestial Daughters bring thee butter: let cows pour butter forth for thee, O Agni.

sections.label: A prayer for deliverance from sin and other evils
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 83

verses.sa:
अप्सु ते राजन् वरुण गृहो हिरण्ययो मिथः ।
ततो धृतव्रतो राजा सर्वा धामानि मुञ्चतु॥
verses.tr: apsu te rājan varuṇa gṛho hiraṇyayo mithaḥ tato dhṛtavrato rājā sarvā dhāmāni muñcatu
verses.en: Stablished amid the waters is, King Varuna, thy golden home. Thence let the Sovran who maintains the statutes loose all binding cords.

verses.sa:
धाम्नोधाम्नो राजन्नितो वरुण मुञ्च नः ।
यदापो अघ्न्या इति वरुणेति यदूचिम ततो वरुण मुञ्च नः॥
verses.tr: dhāmnodhāmno rājannito varuṇa muñca naḥ yadāpo aghnyā iti varuṇeti yadūcima tato varuṇa muñca naḥ
verses.en: Hence free thou us, King Varuna, from each successive bond and tie. As we have cried, O Varuna! have said, The Waters, they are kine, thence set us free, O Varuna.

verses.sa:
उदुत्तमं वरुण पाशमस्मदवाधमं वि मध्यमं श्रथाय ।
अधा वयमादित्य व्रते तवानागसो अदितये स्याम॥
verses.tr: uduttamaṃ varuṇa pāśamasmadavādhamaṃ vi madhyamaṃ śrathāya adhā vayamāditya vrate tavānāgaso aditaye syāma
verses.en: Loosen the bonds, O Varuna, that hold us, loosen the bond above, between, and under. So before Aditi may we be sinless under thy favouring auspices, Aditya!

verses.sa:
प्रास्मत् पाशान् वरुण मुञ्च सर्वान् य उत्तमा अधमा वारुणा ये ।
दुष्वप्न्यं दुरितं नि ष्वास्मदथ गच्छेम सुकृतस्य लोकम्॥
verses.tr: prāsmat pāśān varuṇa muñca sarvān ya uttamā adhamā vāruṇā ye duṣvapnyaṃ duritaṃ ni ṣvāsmadatha gacchema sukṛtasya lokam
verses.en: Varuna, free us from all snares that bind us, Varuna's bonds, the upper and the lower. Drive from us evil dream, drive off misfortune: then let us pass into the world of virtue.

sections.label: A prayer for protection
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 84

verses.sa:
अनाधृष्यो जातवेदा अमर्त्यो विराडग्ने क्षत्रभृद् दीदिहीह।
विश्वा अमीवाः प्रमुञ्चन् मानुषीभिः शिवाभिरद्य परि पाहि नो गयम्॥
verses.tr: anādhṛṣyo jātavedā amartyo virāḍagne kṣatrabhṛd dīdihīha viśvā amīvāḥ pramuñcan mānuṣībhiḥ śivābhiradya pari pāhi no gayam
verses.en: Holder of sway, shine here refulgent, Agni! invincible, immortal Jatavedas. With succours friendly to mankind, auspicious, driving away all maladies, guard our dwelling.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र क्षत्रमभि वाममोजोऽजायथा वृषभ चर्षणीनाम्।
अपानुदो जनममित्रायन्तमुरुं देवेभ्यो अकृणोरु लोकम्॥
verses.tr: indra kṣatramabhi vāmamojo'jāyathā vṛṣabha carṣaṇīnām apānudo janamamitrāyantamuruṃ devebhyo akṛṇoru lokam
verses.en: Thou, Indra, lord and leader of the people, wast born for lovely strength and high dominion. Thou dravest off the folk who were unfriendly, and madest for the Gods wide room and freedom.

verses.sa:
मृगो न भीमः कुचरो गिरिष्ठाः परावत आ जगम्यात् परस्याः ।
सृकं संशाय पविमिन्द्र तिग्मं वि शत्रून् ताढि वि मृघो नुदस्व॥
verses.tr: mṛgo na bhīmaḥ kucaro giriṣṭhāḥ parāvata ā jagamyāt parasyāḥ sṛkaṃ saṃśāya pavimindra tigmaṃ vi śatrūn tāḍhi vi mṛgho nudasva
verses.en: Like a dread wild beast roaming on the mountain, may he approach us from the farthest distance. Whetting thy bolt and thy sharp blade, O Indra, crush down our foes and scatter those who hate us.

sections.label: A charm to ensure victory in battle
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 85

verses.sa:
त्यमू षु वाजिनं देवजूतं सहोवानं तरुतारं रथानाम्।
अरिष्टनेमिं पृतनाजिमाशुं स्वस्तये तार्क्ष्यमिहा हुवेम॥
verses.tr: tyamū ṣu vājinaṃ devajūtaṃ sahovānaṃ tarutāraṃ rathānām ariṣṭanemiṃ pṛtanājimāśuṃ svastaye tārkṣyamihā huvema
verses.en: This very mighty one whom Gods urge onward, the conqueror of cars, ever triumphant, Swift, fleet to battle, with uninjured fellies, even Tarkshya for our weal will we call hither.

sections.label: A charm to ensure victory in battle
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 86

verses.sa:
त्रातारमिन्द्रमवितारमिन्द्रं हवेहवे सुहवं शूरमिन्द्रम्।
हुवे नु शक्रं पुरुहूतमिन्द्रं स्वस्ति न इन्द्रो मघवान् कृणोतु॥
verses.tr: trātāramindramavitāramindraṃ havehave suhavaṃ śūramindram huve nu śakraṃ puruhūtamindraṃ svasti na indro maghavān kṛṇotu
verses.en: Indra the rescuer, Indra the helper, Indra the brave who hears each invocation, Sakra I call, Indra invoked of many. May Indra Maghavan prosper and bless us.

sections.label: A prayer to Rudra as Agni
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 87

verses.sa:
यो अग्नौ रुद्रो यो अप्स्व१न्तर्य ओषधीर्वीरुध आविवेश ।
य इमा विश्वा भुवनानि चाक्लृप तस्मै रुद्राय नमो अस्त्वग्नये॥
verses.tr: yo agnau rudro yo apsva1ntarya oṣadhīrvīrudha āviveśa ya imā viśvā bhuvanāni cāklṛpa tasmai rudrāya namo astvagnaye
verses.en: To Rudra in the fire, to him who dwells in floods, to Rudra who hath entered into herbs and plants, To him who formed and fashioned all these worlds, to him this Rudra, yea, to Agni, reverence be "paid! lightnmg descending with the rain. All these worlds: all living creatures,

sections.label: A charm to cure a snake-bite
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 88

verses.sa:
अपेह्यरिरस्यरिर्वा असि। विषे विषमपृक्था विषमिद् वा अपृक्थाः ।
अहिमेवाभ्यपेहि तं जहि॥
verses.tr: apehyarirasyarirvā asi viṣe viṣamapṛkthā viṣamid vā apṛkthāḥ ahimevābhyapehi taṃ jahi
verses.en: Depart! thou art a foe, a foe. Poison with poison hast thou mixt. Yea, verily poison hast thou mixt. Go to the serpent: strike him dead.

sections.label: A prayer for purification and prosperity
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 89

verses.sa:
अपो दिव्या अचायिषं रसेन समपृक्ष्महि ।
पयस्वानग्न आगमं तं मा सं सृज वर्चसा॥
verses.tr: apo divyā acāyiṣaṃ rasena samapṛkṣmahi payasvānagna āgamaṃ taṃ mā saṃ sṛja varcasā
verses.en: The heavenly Waters have I ranged: we have been sated with their dew. Here, Agni, bearing milk, am I. Endow me with the gift of strength.

verses.sa:
सं माग्ने वर्चसा सृज सं प्रजया समायुषा ।
विद्युर्मे अस्य देवा इन्द्रो विद्यात् सह ऋषिभिः॥
verses.tr: saṃ māgne varcasā sṛja saṃ prajayā samāyuṣā vidyurme asya devā indro vidyāt saha ṛṣibhiḥ
verses.en: Endow me with the gift of strength, with children, and a lengthened life. May the Gods mark this prayer of mine, may Indra with the Rishis mark.

verses.sa:
इदमापः प्र वहतावद्यं च मलं च यत्।
यच्चाभिदुद्रोहानृतं यच्च शेपे अभीरुणम्॥
verses.tr: idamāpaḥ pra vahatāvadyaṃ ca malaṃ ca yat yaccābhidudrohānṛtaṃ yacca śepe abhīruṇam
verses.en: Ye Waters, wash away this stain and whatsoever taint be here, Each sinful wrong that I have done and every harmless curse of mine.

verses.sa:
एधोऽस्येधिषीय समिदसि समेधिषीय ।
तेजोऽसि तेजो मयि धेहि॥
verses.tr: edho'syedhiṣīya samidasi samedhiṣīya tejo'si tejo mayi dhehi
verses.en: Thou art the wood, may I succeed! fuel, may I be glorified! splendour, give splendour unto me.

sections.label: A charm against a rival in love
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 90

verses.sa:
अपि वृश्च पुराणवद् व्रततेरिव गुष्पितम्।
ओजो दास्यस्य दम्भय॥
verses.tr: api vṛśca purāṇavad vratateriva guṣpitam ojo dāsyasya dambhaya
verses.en: Tear thou asunder, as of old, like tangles of a creeping plant. Demolish thou the Dasa's might.

verses.sa:
वयं तदस्य सम्भृतं वस्विन्द्रेण वि भजामहै ।
म्लापयामि भ्रजः शिभ्रं वरुणस्य व्रतेन ते॥
verses.tr: vayaṃ tadasya sambhṛtaṃ vasvindreṇa vi bhajāmahai mlāpayāmi bhrajaḥ śibhraṃ varuṇasya vratena te
verses.en: May we with Indra's help divide the gathered treasure of the foe. I, by the law of Varuna, bring down thy pride and wantonness.

verses.sa:
यथा शेपो अपायातै स्त्रीषु चासदनावयाः ।
अवस्थस्य क्नदीवतः शाङ्-कुरस्य नितोदिनः ।
यदाततमव तत् तनु यदुत्ततं नि तत् तनु॥
verses.tr: yathā śepo apāyātai strīṣu cāsadanāvayāḥ avasthasya knadīvataḥ śāṅ-kurasya nitodinaḥ yadātatamava tat tanu yaduttataṃ ni tat tanu
verses.en: [Griffith gives stanza 3 only in a Latin version, in the Appendix to his translation.]

sections.label: A prayer for protection
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 91

verses.sa:
इन्द्रः सुत्रामा स्ववाँ अवोभिः सुमृडीको भवतु विश्ववेदाः ।
बाधतां द्वेषो अभयं नः कृणोतु सुवीर्यस्य पतयः स्याम॥
verses.tr: indraḥ sutrāmā svavāṃ avobhiḥ sumṛḍīko bhavatu viśvavedāḥ bādhatāṃ dveṣo abhayaṃ naḥ kṛṇotu suvīryasya patayaḥ syāma
verses.en: May Indra with his help, Lord of all treasures, be unto us a careful good protector, Drive off our foes and give us peace and safety. May we be lords of goodly store of heroes.

sections.label: A prayer for protection
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 92

verses.sa:
स सुत्रामा स्ववाँ इन्द्रो अस्मदाराच्चिद् द्वेषः सनुतर्युयोतु ।
तस्य वयं सुमतौ यज्ञियस्यापि भद्रे सौमनसे स्याम॥
verses.tr: sa sutrāmā svavāṃ indro asmadārāccid dveṣaḥ sanutaryuyotu tasya vayaṃ sumatau yajñiyasyāpi bhadre saumanase syāma
verses.en: - May this rich Indra as our good protector keep even far away the men who hate us. May we enjoy his favour, his the holy: may we enjoy his blessed loving-kindness.

sections.label: A prayer for success in battle
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 93

verses.sa:
इन्द्रेण मन्युना वयमभि ष्याम पृतन्यतः ।
घ्नन्तो वृत्राण्यप्रति॥
verses.tr: indreṇa manyunā vayamabhi ṣyāma pṛtanyataḥ ghnanto vṛtrāṇyaprati
verses.en: With Indra's and with Manyu's aid may we subdue our enemies, resistlessly destroying foes.

sections.label: A charm to ensure the obedience of subjects
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 94

verses.sa:
ध्रुवं ध्रुवेण हविषाव सोमं नयामसि ।
यथा न इन्द्रः केवलीर्विशः संमनसस्करत्॥
verses.tr: dhruvaṃ dhruveṇa haviṣāva somaṃ nayāmasi yathā na indraḥ kevalīrviśaḥ saṃmanasaskarat
verses.en: We lead the constant Soma on with constant sacrificial gift, That Indra may make all the tribes unanimous and only ours.

sections.label: An incantation against an undetected thief
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 95

verses.sa:
उदस्य श्यावौ विथुरौ गृध्रौ द्यामिव पेततुः ।
उच्छोचनप्रशोचनावस्योच्छोचनौ हृदः॥
verses.tr: udasya śyāvau vithurau gṛdhrau dyāmiva petatuḥ ucchocanapraśocanāvasyocchocanau hṛdaḥ
verses.en: To heaven, as 'twere, have soared this man's two vultures, staggering, dusky hued, The Parcher and the Drier-up, the pair who parch and dry his heart.

verses.sa:
अहमेनावुदतिष्ठिपं गावौ श्रान्तसदाविव ।
कुर्कुराविव कूजन्तावुदवन्तौ वृकाविव॥
verses.tr: ahamenāvudatiṣṭhipaṃ gāvau śrāntasadāviva kurkurāviva kūjantāvudavantau vṛkāviva
verses.en: I verily have stirred them up like oxen resting after toil, Like two loud-snarling curs, or like two wolves who watch to make their spring:

verses.sa:
आतोदिनौ नितोदिनावथो संतोदिनावुत।
अपि नह्याम्यस्य मेढ्रं य इतः स्त्री पुमान् जभार॥
verses.tr: ātodinau nitodināvatho saṃtodināvuta api nahyāmyasya meḍhraṃ ya itaḥ strī pumān jabhāra
verses.en: Like two that thrust, like two that pierce, like two that strike with mutual blows. I bind the conduit of the man or dame who hence hath taken aught.

sections.label: An incantation against an undetected thief
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 96

verses.sa:
असदन् गावः सदनेऽपप्तद् वसतिं वयः ।
आस्थाने पर्वता अस्थुः स्थाम्नि वृक्कावतिष्ठिपम्॥
verses.tr: asadan gāvaḥ sadane'paptad vasatiṃ vayaḥ āsthāne parvatā asthuḥ sthāmni vṛkkāvatiṣṭhipam
verses.en: The kine are resting in the stall, home to her nest hath flown the bird, The hills are firmly rooted: I have fixed the kidneys in their place.

sections.label: Sacrificial formulas
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 97

verses.sa:
यदद्य त्वा प्रयति यज्ञे अस्मिन् होतश्चिकित्वन्नवृणीमहीह।
ध्रुवमयो ध्रुवमुता शविष्ठ प्रविद्वान् यज्ञमुप याहि सोमम्॥
verses.tr: yadadya tvā prayati yajñe asmin hotaścikitvannavṛṇīmahīha dhruvamayo dhruvamutā śaviṣṭha pravidvān yajñamupa yāhi somam
verses.en: As we have here elected thee, skilled Hotar! to-day as this our sacrifice proceedeth, Come to the firm place, mightiest! yea, come firmly. Knowing the sacrifice, approach the Soma.

verses.sa:
समिन्द्र नो मनसा नेष गोभिः सं सूरिभिर्हरिवन्त्सं स्वस्त्या।
सं ब्रह्मणा देवहितं यदस्ति सं देवानां सुमतौ यज्ञियानाम्॥
verses.tr: samindra no manasā neṣa gobhiḥ saṃ sūribhirharivantsaṃ svastyā saṃ brahmaṇā devahitaṃ yadasti saṃ devānāṃ sumatau yajñiyānām
verses.en: "With kine connect us, and with spirit, Indra! Lord of Bay Steeds, with princes and with favour, With the God-destined portion of the Brahmans, and the good-will of Gods who merit worship.

verses.sa:
यानावह उशतो देव देवांस्तान् प्रेरय स्वे अग्ने सधस्थे ।
जक्षिवांसः पपिवांसो मधून्यस्मै धत्त वसवो वसूनि॥
verses.tr: yānāvaha uśato deva devāṃstān preraya sve agne sadhasthe jakṣivāṃsaḥ papivāṃso madhūnyasmai dhatta vasavo vasūni
verses.en: The willing Gods whom, God, thou hast brought hither, send thou to their own dwelling-place, A Agni. When have eaten and have drunk sweet juices, endow this man with precious wealth, ye Vasus.

verses.sa:
सुगा वो देवाः सदना अकर्म य आजग्म सवने मा जुषाणाः ।
वहमाना भरमाणाः स्वा वसूनि वसुं घर्मं दिवमा रोहतानु॥
verses.tr: sugā vo devāḥ sadanā akarma ya ājagma savane mā juṣāṇāḥ vahamānā bharamāṇāḥ svā vasūni vasuṃ gharmaṃ divamā rohatānu
verses.en: Gods, we have made your seats of easy access, who, pleased with me, have come to my libation. Bearing and bringing hitherward your treasures, after the rich warm beverage mount to heaven.

verses.sa:
यज्ञ यज्ञं गच्छ यज्ञपतिं गच्छ ।
स्वां योनिं गच्छ स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: yajña yajñaṃ gaccha yajñapatiṃ gaccha svāṃ yoniṃ gaccha svāhā
verses.en: Go to the sacrifice, go to its master, Sacrifice! To thy birth-place go with Svaha.

verses.sa:
एष ते यज्ञो यज्ञपते सहसूक्तवाकः ।
सुवीर्यः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: eṣa te yajño yajñapate sahasūktavākaḥ suvīryaḥ svāhā
verses.en: This is thy sacrifice with holy hymnal, Lord of the. Rite, Svaha! and fraught with vigour.

verses.sa:
वषड् ढुतेभ्यो वषडहुतेभ्यः ।
देवा गातुविदो गातुं वित्त्वा गातुमित॥
verses.tr: vaṣaḍ ḍhutebhyo vaṣaḍahutebhyaḥ devā gātuvido gātuṃ vittvā gātumita
verses.en: Vashat to paid and yet unpaid oblations! Ye Gods who know the way, find and pursue it!

verses.sa:
मनसस्पत इमं नो दिवि देवेषु यज्ञम्।
स्वाहा दिवि स्वाहा पृथिव्यां स्वाहान्तरिक्षे स्वाहा वाते धां स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: manasaspata imaṃ no divi deveṣu yajñam svāhā divi svāhā pṛthivyāṃ svāhāntarikṣe svāhā vāte dhāṃ svāhā
verses.en: Lord of the Mind, lay this our sacrifice in heaven among the Gods, Svaha in heaven! Svftm on earth! Svaha in air! In wind have I paid offerings. Hail!

sections.label: Anointing the sacred grass
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 98

verses.sa:
सं बर्हिरक्तं हविषा घृतेन समिन्द्रेण वसुना सं मरुद्भिः ।
सं देवैर्विश्वदेवेभिरक्तमिन्द्रं गच्छतु हविः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: saṃ barhiraktaṃ haviṣā ghṛtena samindreṇa vasunā saṃ marudbhiḥ saṃ devairviśvadevebhiraktamindraṃ gacchatu haviḥ svāhā
verses.en: Balmed is the Grass with butter and libation, with Indra gracious Lord, and with the Maruts. Hail! let the sacrifice go forth anointed to Indra with the Gods and Visve Devas.

sections.label: The preparation of the altar
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 99

verses.sa:
परि स्तृणीहि परि धेहि वेदिं मा जामिं मोषीरमुया शयानाम्।
होतृषदनं हरितं हिरण्ययं निष्का एते यजमानस्य लोके॥
verses.tr: pari stṛṇīhi pari dhehi vediṃ mā jāmiṃ moṣīramuyā śayānām hotṛṣadanaṃ haritaṃ hiraṇyayaṃ niṣkā ete yajamānasya loke
verses.en: Strew thou the Grass, and spread it on the Altar: rob not the sister who is lying yonder. The Hotar's seat is green and golden: these are gold necklets in the place of him who worships.

sections.label: A charm against nightmare
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 100

verses.sa:
पर्यावर्ते दुष्वप्न्यात् पापात् स्वप्न्यादभूत्याः ।
ब्रह्माहमन्तरं कृण्वे परा स्वप्नमुखाः शुचः॥
verses.tr: paryāvarte duṣvapnyāt pāpāt svapnyādabhūtyāḥ brahmāhamantaraṃ kṛṇve parā svapnamukhāḥ śucaḥ
verses.en: I Turn away from evil dream, from dream of sin, from indigence. I make the prayer mine inmost friend. Hence! torturing dreamy phantasies!

sections.label: A charm against nightmare
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 101

verses.sa:
यत् स्वप्ने अन्नमश्नामि न प्रातरधिगम्यते ।
सर्वं तदस्तु मे शिवं नहि तद् दृष्यते दिवा॥
verses.tr: yat svapne annamaśnāmi na prātaradhigamyate sarvaṃ tadastu me śivaṃ nahi tad dṛṣyate divā
verses.en: The food that in a dream I eat is not perceived at early morn. May all that food be blest to me because it is not seen by day.

sections.label: A charm to obtain pardon for an indecent act
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 102

verses.sa:
नमस्कृत्य द्यावापृथिवीभ्यामन्तरिक्षाय मृत्यवे ।
मेक्षाम्यूर्ध्वस्तिष्ठन् मा मा हिंसिषुरीश्वराः॥
verses.tr: namaskṛtya dyāvāpṛthivībhyāmantarikṣāya mṛtyave mekṣāmyūrdhvastiṣṭhan mā mā hiṃsiṣurīśvarāḥ
verses.en: When I have worshipped Heaven and Earth, reverenced Firmament and Death, I will make water standing up. Let not the Sovrans injure me.

sections.label: The cry of an unemployed priest
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 103

verses.sa:
को अस्या नो द्रुहोऽवद्यवत्या उन्नेष्यति क्षत्रियो वस्य इच्छन्।
को यज्ञकामः क उ पूर्तिकामः को देवेषु वनुते दीर्घमायुः॥
verses.tr: ko asyā no druho'vadyavatyā unneṣyati kṣatriyo vasya icchan ko yajñakāmaḥ ka u pūrtikāmaḥ ko deveṣu vanute dīrghamāyuḥ
verses.en: What princely warrior, seeking higher fortune, will free us from this shameful fiend of mischief? What friend of sacrifice? what guerdon-lover? Who winneth 'mid the Gods a long existence?

sections.label: A prayer for prosperity
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 104

verses.sa:
कः पृश्निं धेनुं वरुणेन दत्तामथर्वने सुदुघां नित्यवत्साम्।
बृहस्पतिना सख्यंऽ जुषाणो यथावशं तन्वः कल्पयाति॥
verses.tr: kaḥ pṛśniṃ dhenuṃ varuṇena dattāmatharvane sudughāṃ nityavatsām bṛhaspatinā sakhyaṃ' juṣāṇo yathāvaśaṃ tanvaḥ kalpayāti
verses.en: Who will prepare the dappled Cow, good milker, ne'er without calf, whom Varuna gave Atharvan, And, joying in Brihaspati' s alliance, arrange according to his will her body?

sections.label: An initiation formula
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 105

verses.sa:
अपक्रामन् पौरुषेयाद् वृणानो दैव्यं वचः ।
प्रणीतीरभ्यावर्तस्व विश्वेभिः सखिभिः सह॥
verses.tr: apakrāman pauruṣeyād vṛṇāno daivyaṃ vacaḥ praṇītīrabhyāvartasva viśvebhiḥ sakhibhiḥ saha
verses.en: Leaving humanity behind, making the heavenly word thy choice, With all thy friends address thyself to furthering and guiding men.

sections.label: A prayer for pardon of sin
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 106

verses.sa:
यदस्मृति चकृम किं चिदग्न उपारिम चरणे जातवेदः ।
ततः पाहि त्वं नः प्रचेतः शुभे सखिभ्यो अमृतत्वमस्तु नः॥
verses.tr: yadasmṛti cakṛma kiṃ cidagna upārima caraṇe jātavedaḥ tataḥ pāhi tvaṃ naḥ pracetaḥ śubhe sakhibhyo amṛtatvamastu naḥ
verses.en: Each thoughtless ill that we have done, O Agni, all error in our conduct, Jatavedas! Therefrom do thou, O sapient God, preserve us. May we thy friends, for bliss, have life eternal.

sections.label: A charm against Cough
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 107

verses.sa:
अव दिवस्तारयन्ति सप्त सूर्यस्य रश्मयः ।
आपः समुद्रिया धारास्तास्ते शल्यमसिस्रसन्॥
verses.tr: ava divastārayanti sapta sūryasya raśmayaḥ āpaḥ samudriyā dhārāstāste śalyamasisrasan
verses.en: The seven bright beams of Surya bring the waters downward from the sky, The streams of ocean: these have made the sting that pained thee drop away.

sections.label: A prayer for protection
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 108

verses.sa:
यो नस्तायद् दिप्सति यो न आविः स्वो विद्वानरणो वा नो अग्ने ।
प्रतीच्येत्वरणी दत्वती तान् मैषामग्ने वास्तु भून्मो अपत्यम्॥
verses.tr: yo nastāyad dipsati yo na āviḥ svo vidvānaraṇo vā no agne pratīcyetvaraṇī datvatī tān maiṣāmagne vāstu bhūnmo apatyam
verses.en: Whoso by stealth or openly would harm us, a friend who knows us, or a stranger, Agni! May the strange she-fiend armed with teeth attack them: O Agni, theirs be neither home nor children!

verses.sa:
यो नः सुप्तान् जाग्रतो वाभिदासात् तिष्ठतो वा चरतो जातवेदः ।
वैश्वानरेण सयुजा सजोषास्तान् प्रतीचो निर्दह जातवेदः॥
verses.tr: yo naḥ suptān jāgrato vābhidāsāt tiṣṭhato vā carato jātavedaḥ vaiśvānareṇa sayujā sajoṣāstān pratīco nirdaha jātavedaḥ
verses.en: Whoso oppresseth us, O Jatavedas, asleep or waking, standing still or moving, Accordant with Vaisvanara thy comrade, O Jatavedas, meet them and consume them.

sections.label: A prayer for success in gambling
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 109

verses.sa:
इदमुग्राय बभ्रवे नमो यो अक्षेषु तनूवशी।
घृतेन कलिं शिक्षामि स नो मृडातीदृशे॥
verses.tr: idamugrāya babhrave namo yo akṣeṣu tanūvaśī ghṛtena kaliṃ śikṣāmi sa no mṛḍātīdṛśe
verses.en: My homage to the strong, the brown, the sovran lord among the dice! Butter on Kali I bestow: may he be kind to one like me.

verses.sa:
घृतमप्सराभ्यो वह त्वमग्ने पांसूनक्षेभ्यः सिकता अपश्च ।
यथाभगं हव्यदातिं जुषाणा मदन्ति देवा उभयानि हव्या॥
verses.tr: ghṛtamapsarābhyo vaha tvamagne pāṃsūnakṣebhyaḥ sikatā apaśca yathābhagaṃ havyadātiṃ juṣāṇā madanti devā ubhayāni havyā
verses.en: Bear butter to the Apsarases, O Agni, and to the Dice bear dust and sand and water. The Gods delight in both oblations, joying in sacrificial gifts apportioned duly.

verses.sa:
अप्सरसः सधमादं मदन्ति हविर्धानमन्तरा सूर्यं च ।
ता मे हस्तौ सं सृजन्तु घृतेन सपत्नं मे कितवं रन्धयन्तु॥
verses.tr: apsarasaḥ sadhamādaṃ madanti havirdhānamantarā sūryaṃ ca tā me hastau saṃ sṛjantu ghṛtena sapatnaṃ me kitavaṃ randhayantu
verses.en: The Apsarases take pleasure in the banquet between the Sun and the libation-holder. With butter let them fill my hands, and give me, to be my prey, the man who plays against me.

verses.sa:
आदिनवं प्रतिदीव्ने घृतेनास्माँ अभि क्षर ।
वृक्षमिवाशन्या जहि यो अस्मान् प्रतिदीव्यति॥
verses.tr: ādinavaṃ pratidīvne ghṛtenāsmāṃ abhi kṣara vṛkṣamivāśanyā jahi yo asmān pratidīvyati
verses.en: Evil be mine opponent's luck! Sprinkle thou butter over us. Strike, as a tree with lightning flash, mine adversary in the game.

verses.sa:
यो नो द्युवे धनमिदं चकार यो अक्षाणां ग्लहनं शेषणं च ।
स नो देवो हविरिदं जुषाणो गन्धर्वेभिः सधमादं मदेम॥
verses.tr: yo no dyuve dhanamidaṃ cakāra yo akṣāṇāṃ glahanaṃ śeṣaṇaṃ ca sa no devo haviridaṃ juṣāṇo gandharvebhiḥ sadhamādaṃ madema
verses.en: The God who found for us this wealth for gambling, to cast the dice and count the winning number, May he accept the sacrifice we offer, and with Gandharvas revel in the banquet.

verses.sa:
संवसव इति वो नामधेयमुग्रंपश्या राष्ट्रभृतो ह्य१क्षाः ।
तेभ्यो व इन्दवो हविषा विधेम वयं स्याम पतयो रयीणाम्॥
verses.tr: saṃvasava iti vo nāmadheyamugraṃpaśyā rāṣṭrabhṛto hya1kṣāḥ tebhyo va indavo haviṣā vidhema vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām
verses.en: Fellow-inhabitants, such is your title, for Dice with looks of power support dominion. As such with offerings may we serve you, Indus! May we have riches in our own possession.

verses.sa:
देवान् यन्नाथितो हुवे ब्रह्मचर्यं यदूषिम।
अक्षान् यद् बभ्रूनालभे ते नो मृडन्त्वीदृशे॥
verses.tr: devān yannāthito huve brahmacaryaṃ yadūṣima akṣān yad babhrūnālabhe te no mṛḍantvīdṛśe
verses.en: As I invoke the Gods at need, as I have lived in chastity, May these, when I have grasped the Dice, the brown, be kind to one like me.

sections.label: A prayer for success in battle
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 110

verses.sa:
अग्न इन्द्रश्च दाशुषे हतो वृत्राण्यप्रति।
उभा हि वृत्रहन्तमा॥
verses.tr: agna indraśca dāśuṣe hato vṛtrāṇyaprati ubhā hi vṛtrahantamā
verses.en: Resistless, Agni, Indra, smite his foemen for the worshipper, For best foe-slayers are ye both.

verses.sa:
याभ्यामजयन्त्स्व१रग्र एव यावातस्थतुर्भुवनानि विश्वा ।
प्रचर्षणी वृषणा वज्रबाहू अग्निमिन्द्रं वृत्रहणा हुवेऽहम्॥
verses.tr: yābhyāmajayantsva1ragra eva yāvātasthaturbhuvanāni viśvā pracarṣaṇī vṛṣaṇā vajrabāhū agnimindraṃ vṛtrahaṇā huve'ham
verses.en: Agni I call, and Indra, foe-destroyers, swift moving, heroes, Gods who wield the thunder, Through whom they won the light in the beginning, these who have made all worlds their habitation.

verses.sa:
उप त्वा देवो अग्रमीच्चमसेन बृहस्पतिः ।
इन्द्र गीर्भिर्न आ विश यजमानाय सुन्वते॥
verses.tr: upa tvā devo agramīccamasena bṛhaspatiḥ indra gīrbhirna ā viśa yajamānāya sunvate
verses.en: The God Brihaspati hath won thy friendly favour with the cup. With hymns, O Indra, enter us for the juice-pouring worshipper.

sections.label: A prayer for offspring
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 111

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्य कुक्षिरसि सोमधान आत्मा देवानामुत मानुषाणाम्।
इह प्रजा जनय यास्त आसु या अन्यत्रेह तास्ते रमन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: indrasya kukṣirasi somadhāna ātmā devānāmuta mānuṣāṇām iha prajā janaya yāsta āsu yā anyatreha tāste ramantām
verses.en: Belly of Indra art thou, Soma-holder! the very soul of Gods and human beings. Here be the sire of offspring, thine here present! Here be they glad in thee who now are elsewhere.

sections.label: A prayer for protection and freedom from sin
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 112

verses.sa:
शुम्भनी द्यावापृथिवी अन्तिसुम्ने महिव्रते ।
आपः सप्त सुस्रुवुर्देवीस्ता नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: śumbhanī dyāvāpṛthivī antisumne mahivrate āpaḥ sapta susruvurdevīstā no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Radiant with light are Heaven and Earth, whose grace is nigh, whose sway is vast. Seven Goddesses have flowed to us: may they deliver us from woe;

verses.sa:
मुञ्चन्तु मा शपथ्या३दथो वरुण्याऽदुत।
अथो यमस्य पड्वीशाद् विश्वस्माद् देवकिल्बिषात्॥
verses.tr: muñcantu mā śapathyā3datho varuṇyā'duta atho yamasya paḍvīśād viśvasmād devakilbiṣāt
verses.en: Release me from the curse's bond and plague that comes from Varuna; Free me from Yama's fetter and from every sin against the Gods.

sections.label: A woman's incantation against a rival
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 113

verses.sa:
तृष्टिके तृष्टवन्दन उदमूं छिन्धि तृष्टिके ।
यथा कृतद्विष्टासोऽमुष्मै शेप्यावते॥
verses.tr: tṛṣṭike tṛṣṭavandana udamūṃ chindhi tṛṣṭike yathā kṛtadviṣṭāso'muṣmai śepyāvate
verses.en: Rough Plant, thou rough rude parasite, cut thou that man, O Rough and Rude, That thou mayst hinder from his act that man in all his manly strength.

verses.sa:
तृष्टासि तृष्टिका विषा विषातक्यऽसि ।
परिवृक्ता यथासस्यृषभस्य वशेव॥
verses.tr: tṛṣṭāsi tṛṣṭikā viṣā viṣātakya'si parivṛktā yathāsasyṛṣabhasya vaśeva
verses.en: Thou, rugged Plant, art rude and rough, Visha, Vishataki art thou, A prayer for progeny. That thou mayst be cast off by him, as by a bull a barren cow.

sections.label: A woman's incantation against a rival
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 114

verses.sa:
आ ते ददे वक्षणाभ्य आ तेऽहं हृदयाद् ददे ।
आ ते मुखस्य सङ्काशात् सर्वं ते वर्च आ ददे॥
verses.tr: ā te dade vakṣaṇābhya ā te'haṃ hṛdayād dade ā te mukhasya saṅkāśāt sarvaṃ te varca ā dade
verses.en: I Have extracted from thy sides, I have extracted from thy heart, I have extracted from thy face the strength and splendour that were thine.

verses.sa:
प्रेतो यन्तु व्याऽध्यः प्रानुध्याः प्रो अशस्तयः ।
अग्नी रक्षस्विनीर्हन्तु सोमो हन्तु दुरस्यतीः॥
verses.tr: preto yantu vyā'dhyaḥ prānudhyāḥ pro aśastayaḥ agnī rakṣasvinīrhantu somo hantu durasyatīḥ
verses.en: Let pain and suffering pass away, let cares and curses vanish hence. Let Agni slay the fiendish hags, Soma kill hags who trouble us.

sections.label: A charm against Misfortune
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 115

verses.sa:
प्र पतेतः पापि लक्ष्मि नश्येतः प्रामुतः पत ।
अयस्मयेनाङ्केन द्विषते त्वा सजामसि॥
verses.tr: pra patetaḥ pāpi lakṣmi naśyetaḥ prāmutaḥ pata ayasmayenāṅkena dviṣate tvā sajāmasi
verses.en: Hence, Evil Fortune! fly away, vanish from this place and from that. We fix thee with an iron hook unto the man who hateth us.

verses.sa:
या मा लक्ष्मीः पतयालूरजुष्टाभिचस्कन्द वन्दनेव वृक्षम्।
अन्यत्रास्मत् सवितस्तामितो धा हिरण्यहस्तो वसु नो रराणः॥
verses.tr: yā mā lakṣmīḥ patayālūrajuṣṭābhicaskanda vandaneva vṛkṣam anyatrāsmat savitastāmito dhā hiraṇyahasto vasu no rarāṇaḥ
verses.en: Granting us riches, Savitar! golden-handed, send thou away from us to other regions That Fortune who, flying, abominable, hath, as a creeper climbs a tree, assailed me.

verses.sa:
एकशतं लक्ष्म्यो३मर्त्यस्य साकं तन्वाऽजनुषोऽधि जाताः ।
तासां पापिष्ठा निरितः प्र हिण्मः शिवा अस्मभ्यं जातवेदो नि यच्छ॥
verses.tr: ekaśataṃ lakṣmyo3martyasya sākaṃ tanvā'januṣo'dhi jātāḥ tāsāṃ pāpiṣṭhā niritaḥ pra hiṇmaḥ śivā asmabhyaṃ jātavedo ni yaccha
verses.en: One and a hundred Fortunes all together are at his birth born with a mortal's body. Of these we send away the most unlucky: keep lucky ones for us, O Jatavedas.

verses.sa:
एता एना व्याकरं खिले गा विष्ठिता इव ।
रमन्तां पुण्या लक्ष्मीर्याः पापीस्ता अनीनशम्॥
verses.tr: etā enā vyākaraṃ khile gā viṣṭhitā iva ramantāṃ puṇyā lakṣmīryāḥ pāpīstā anīnaśam
verses.en: I have disparted these and those like cows who stray on common land. Here let auspicious Fortunes stay: hence have I banished evil ones.

sections.label: A charm against Fever
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 116

verses.sa:
नमो रूराय च्यवनाय नोदनाय धृष्णवे ।
नमः शीताय पूर्वकामकृत्वने॥
verses.tr: namo rūrāya cyavanāya nodanāya dhṛṣṇave namaḥ śītāya pūrvakāmakṛtvane
verses.en: Homage to him the burning one, shaker, exciter, violent! Homage to him the cold who acts according to his ancient will!

verses.sa: यो अन्येद्युरुभयद्युरभ्येतीमं मण्डूकमभ्येऽत्वव्रतः॥
verses.tr: yo anyedyurubhayadyurabhyetīmaṃ maṇḍūkamabhye'tvavrataḥ
verses.en: May he, the lawless one, who comes alternate or two following days, pass over and possess the frog.

sections.label: A charm to ensure prosperity
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 117

verses.sa:
आ मन्द्रैरिन्द्र हरिभिर्याहि मयूररोमभिः ।
मा त्वा के चिद् वि यमन् विं न पाशिनोऽति धन्वेव ताँ इहि॥
verses.tr: ā mandrairindra haribhiryāhi mayūraromabhiḥ mā tvā ke cid vi yaman viṃ na pāśino'ti dhanveva tāṃ ihi
verses.en: Comes hither, Indra, with bay steeds, joyous, with tails like peacock plumes. Let none impede thy way as fowlers stay the bird: pass o'er them as o'er desert lands.

sections.label: A benediction on a warrior
sections.name: Book 7, hymn 118

verses.sa:
मर्माणि ते वर्मणा छादयामि सोमस्त्वा राजामृतेनानु वस्ताम्।
उरोर्वरीयो वरुणस्ते कृणोतु जयन्तं त्वानु देवा मदन्तु॥
verses.tr: marmāṇi te varmaṇā chādayāmi somastvā rājāmṛtenānu vastām urorvarīyo varuṇaste kṛṇotu jayantaṃ tvānu devā madantu
verses.en: Thy vital parts I cover with thine armour: with immortality King Soma clothe thee! f Varuna give thee what is more than ample, and in thy triumph let the Gods be joyful.
